Now that he’s officially running for re-election, it’s our job to continue building a campaign strong enough to defeat him and expand our majority. | | Dear Peter, We had a great time celebrating the enforcement of the Emancipation Proclamation at the Juneteenth celebration this past Saturday!! It is great to know we are first free in Christ, and we can celebrate that freedom, and the physical freedom declared from the horrific establishment of slavery in the US.
---
|
---
---
| This week we have a couple important events. The first event is tomorrow evening in Orange county, and we need people to come and join to **_voice concerns for our 1st amendment rights_**. See below for details:

TUESDAY, JUNE 21. If you can, meet at 6:30pm to PEACEFULLY protest outside the Whitted Building, 300 W. Tryon St in Hillsborough. Then at 7:00, sign up to speak (limited to 3 minutes) or be present to support those who are speaking out. Each person is allowed 3 minutes to speak, so practice and time yourself and they are limiting public comment to one hour total.

The complete agenda for the June 21 meeting is [at this link](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=e9882aea2b&e=20ac8f046f).

The Orange County Board of Commissioners will vote on a regulation that is an unequivocal and _**sweeping violation of the First Amendment rights**_ of every Orange County Citizen.

The First Amendment states: Congress shall make no law respecting an establishment of religion, or prohibiting the free exercise thereof; or abridging the freedom of speech, or of the press; or the right of the people peaceably to assemble, and to petition the Government for a redress of grievances.

The new regulation the board is voting on will make it illegal for: one or more persons to gather for any common purpose including but not limited to vigil, protest, observation, demonstration, or other action which promotes or objects to a person, policy, political candidate, issue, or action.

This regulation, which may be adopted by Orange County TOMORROW night, will apply to anyone gathering for any purpose on or within 1,000 feet of any school property or any playground in Orange County.

This means that in Orange County:
* It will be illegal for parents to gather at a school property for the common purpose of discussing school policies, asking questions about events that have occurred, speaking about ideas for improvement, or raising questions about policies or actions they disagree with. According to the law, these types of actions would constitute a violation: _**gathering to promote, or object to, an issue or action**_.
* Likewise, it will be illegal for an individual parent to come on or near school grounds, to either support or object to the actions of any teacher or administrator or to support or object to any issue at their child's school. According to the law, this type of action would constitute a violation: _**one or more persons acting to promote or object to a person, policy, issue, or action**_.
* It will be illegal for a family, or group of neighbors, to gather at Gold Park for a Fourth of July Celebration. According to the law, this type of action would constitute a violation: _**gathering to promote the issue of Liberty**_.
* In the event of the sudden loss of a beloved individual, it will be illegal for the community to hold a vigil or observation to support each other and grieve on or near school property or at/near parks with playgrounds. According to the law, this type of action would constitute a violation: _**gathering to vigil and gathering to promote a person**_.

This law violates our fundamental rights:
* By abridging the _**freedom of speech**_
* By abridging the _**right of the people peaceably to assemble**_
* By abridging the _**right of the people to petition the Government for a redress of grievances**_

While this law would be egregious if passed... if we allow it to pass, we’re opening the door to our county government enhancing the law to prevent freedom of speech and assembly on any government or public property.

Unlike recent school board policies that were quietly passed without the knowledge of most of the community, we have a chance to make our voices heard before this law passes.

_**This is a time where our community needs to act!**_ Please take the time today to help prevent our rights from being stripped away. Please forward to your local friends and family.

The second event this week is this Friday, June 24. We will be hosting a showing of the recent movie "_**2000 Mules**_." I have already seen the movie, and it is an objective presentation of illegalities in the 2020 election. People may say, why live in the past? We have to know history to prevent reoccurrences. True The Vote has filed multiple lawsuits with this information that has been dismissed for "lack of standing." When you see this presentation, you will see there is plenty of standing. Come with an open mind! This should not be a partisan issue. To PROTECT the vote, we need every legal vote to count. When an illegal vote cancels out a legal vote... well there is your definition of injustice.

United States would be "forever free.” [http://email.email.jennifer-ruth.com/c/eJxtjs1KxDAAhJ9mc7OkSdO0hxz2YN3KKuiiC15K_ppG06QmlbJvb-pZGJiBGYZPDlax7nTsb-n-63IhL88Lx753V-CC3Dt9lqePsf9Gm7lWt7g14u0dKNZAAZECliGIEKxRCcuqJWVRwRKpWjatoBILxQ8V1DO3rvjU3ttRx7v4s06FDDOYWEUoacaW4rGVWsgWcc0xJViWAhOtKXBsWtclHfDxgLqstIbIjS5MCMZpvti0P-ViTiZ5FXP6j3cfaGV59sfXh6GznrtzMGF44tYXizcgMrVs1jmbapqRzR9yvv4FEXBdEQ]
Juneteenth Op-Ed

Over 159 years ago, on January 1, 1863, Abraham Lincoln published the Emancipation Proclamation declaring that all slaves in the
United States would be "forever free.” Juneteenth commemorates the day in 1865 when news of the Emancipation Proclamation reached
the people of Galveston, TX, freeing
slaves in the last rebel state. Although President Lincoln had made the declaration, it wasn’t enforced in Galveston until federal
soldiers read it out on June 19, 1865.

Juneteenth is the day the last slaves were able to recognize their freedom for the first time.

Reflecting on this day, I was not sure whether today was a day we should celebrate or if it should be a day of mourning,
recognizing that there were people who were enslaved for two and a half years after the President declared them free. Regardless,
I am grateful we can acknowledge the history of our nation, and my hope is that we can continue to learn and grow from the
inhumane choices of the past.

My learning points focus on the fact that slavery ended two generations ago, and America has progressed. First, this is a precious
time to reflect on the values for which Dr. Martin Luther King and so many others passionately fought. He fought for civil rights,
and he fought to end racism in America. He saw that people continued to be judged by the color of their skin and not the content
of their character. The racial divide was a consistent reality, and I am pleased people were committed not to stand idly by after
evaluating the status quo.

My second learning point is that I am accountable to ensure I do not stand idly by in today’s America. I am the sixth child of an
African-American father and a half African-American/half Filipina. I think about my father’s father, and how he was able to earn
the rank of Chief Master Sergeant in the US Air Force. I think about my father, and how he earned the rank of Senior Master
Sergeant in the US Air Force. I entered the Air Force as a cadet at the USAF Academy and currently serve as a Lt Col in the
Indiana Air National Guard. I was privileged to serve as the first African American / Filipina Commander in my entire unit’s
history. These accomplishments were not in a vacuum, and I am reminded how important it is not to limit progress to our own
individual environments. My good friend, Chris Campbell, once said, “There’s no point in blazing a trail if the trail doesn’t
become a road.”

My ancestors were enslaved. Juneteenth celebrates the day that the freedom of all slaves was recognized. African-American social
progress was led by many committed people focused on not allowing slavery to be a continued crippling force. We are not where we
ought to be, but thank God, we are not where we used to be. I am my ancestors’ wildest dreams, and I am committed to serving
others to ensure I own the responsibility to pave the road to progress.

I’m thinking about the fact that for decades the elite of the Democratic party has aimed to convince people who look like me in
northwest Indiana and across America, that they can't be conservative. They say they can't be pro-God and pro-family. They say we
can't value hard work, can't be tough on crime, and can't support fiscal responsibility. They have put us in a box that has been
nearly impossible to escape. They insist that we have to act and think the way they tell us. Well, they're wrong. It's time we
think outside the box. This is your opportunity to rethink norms and blaze a trail for the next generation.

My name is Jennifer-Ruth Green. I'm a conservative African-American woman, and I'm running for Congress in Indiana's first
district. I am running to represent you and to be your voice. Let's stop repeating the past and start creating a new future of
equal opportunity for all.

Today, Tuesday, June 21st, is the Virginia Primary and I want to make sure you cast your ballot to shape a future that works for everyone!
🗳If you are voting in-person , polls in Virginia are open from 6:00 AM to 7:00 PM so make sure to follow through with your plan to vote TODAY if you haven't already.

🗳If you need to return your absentee ballot , you can drop it off at your local registrar's office by 7:00 PM TODAY, or drop it off at your post office to make sure it is postmarked TODAY.
Lastly, I want to say how incredibly humbled I am of the campaign we've built. Together, we built a diverse coalition in Virginia's 8th who are ready for representation that reflects our lived experiences. No matter what happens, I know that our grassroots movement will continue to fight and make your voice heard.
Your support means everything. Thank you!
Victoria

body:

[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zennb0q7u40euup2gakjprog6ebi9llev4vjlo70_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3g6aor2cph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm4qj6d9jmpqj7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65t1le9g6bd5gs8o66chkmuor2tdhm3inepbgeerb9cji6com4cb3ccq7codhmsrjfkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj33d5lmhjrcpb664ob6phnm2qmash5u)

Friend,
**Our country is currently facing a great threat.** A new enemy has emerged from the shadows that seeks to destroy and intimidate their way to a transformed state, and country, that you and I would hardly recognize.
This enemy is the radical vigilante woke mob that will steamroll anything and anyone in their way. Their blatant attacks on the American way of life are clear and intensifying: stifling dissent, public shaming, rampant violence, and a perverted version of history.
A group that will, literally, tear down monuments and buildings but — perhaps in an even more sinister way — tear down the American spirit itself. **They go after the family unit, parental rights, traditional moral values, the church, and fact-based education.**
Over the past few years, we’ve watched horrified as this group has attempted to _**brainwash our children**_ into thinking we live in an evil, racist, irredeemable country.
We listened to them deny science and data to exert political theater all the while _**trampling over personal liberties enshrined in the Constitution.**_
[**> > DONATE NOW TO HELP US CONTINUE THE FIGHT <<**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zpej5koe8uj1tp3lclu88s9hnpbh06s4fc7iotv8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3g6aor2cph2bs)
We saw them take to the streets for an entire summer like outlaws burning, looting, and destroying everything in sight while being told they were “mostly peaceful” and “passionate.”
We watched _**Big Tech moguls in Silicon Valley be the arbiters of truth**_ – deciding who gets to speak and who gets silenced through the digital public square.
We listened to the legacy media muffle legitimately verifiable news stories that didn’t align with their preferred narrative, only to watch the truth trickle out months later at a more politically expedient time.
**Well,****Friend****, the time for listening and watching from the sidelines is over.**
This enemy has taken over media, educational institutions, corporate boards, professional sports, foundations, and professional institutions. They have left no corner of our lives untouched. But all hope is not lost.
**We The People still have a say.** We know the truth, you and I, about America and the country she is and can be. We must fight to defeat these false pretenses and predetermined narratives.
**I am choosing to counter this enemy with faith, with reason, and with freedom. As Governor of the Free State of Florida, I have chosen to lead with a vision that builds America up rather than tears it down.**
Together we can ensure that our children are raised to know they live in the greatest state in the nation, the greatest country in the world and that they have an opportunity to continue making them even greater.
[**If you’ve been waiting for the right time to get off the sidelines and fight for the rights you know were given to man by God Himself – the time is NOW.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ztqpnh8j9rdreb9nqia88ffaihlltrpp3bp05uqo_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3g6aor2cph2bs)
[**If you’re with me,**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z0np9uujk73fgfdjap4vq3u6ah8q8tdcpt5s5nfo_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3g6aor2cph2bs)[**Friend****, chip in any amount to help me defeat this enemy.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ztf15rs0psnff5vp61h6bs9ps4q5727s9igj3qno_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3g6aor2cph2bs) I can’t do it without you. I promise you; I will _**never**_ stop fighting.
Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis
[CHIP IN NOW](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zao50n7enf07c7ats8lg2nqp2j8bva1a2i2of9ag_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3g6aor2cph2bs)

I hope you take advantage of this offer, and I have included a secure link for you here: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/constitution-101-dvd/**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c35902%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7OXC0zCiCfwLTOwYuospxw&sysid=1) As you know, Hillsdale takes no government funding, even indirectly in the form of student grants or loans. As I mentioned above, supplies of the new “Constitution 101” DVD box set are limited, so I hope you’ll reserve your copy today. | | Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family.

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

A few
years ago, New York magazine posed the question: "When Did
Everyone Become a Socialist?"

This is,
of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left
in America aims to bring about a "Great Reset" of our economy and
our way of life.

In a
recent issue of Imprimis-Hillsdale College's digest of
liberty-author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of
the Great Reset as "'capitalism with Chinese characteristics'-a
two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on
top and socialism for the majority below."

Today, as
a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand
the extent of support for-and opposition to-socialism.

Your
input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight
for the future of liberty in our country.

Will you
please share your views on the political, social, and cultural
forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your
National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/

Sadly,
socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the
young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that...

. . .
during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those
16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also
increased in popularity among all ages.

Why is
this?

Draconian
government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated
competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream
come true for corporate socialists.

At the
same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what
socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures
wherever it has been tried.

This is a
result of the far-Left's "long march through the
institutions"-including colleges and universities, K-12 schools,
and the media.

Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once
confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race
theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as
school boards and even the military.

But it is
in our schools where the effects of critical race theory-which
teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens
according to race-are most dangerous.

You may
recall that many young Americans with college degrees who
championed socialist policies participated in the riots and
violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020.

In the
face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free
markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale's work to reach and
teach millions has never been more urgently needed.

That's
why I need your thoughts quickly.

By
responding to the National Survey on Socialism in the next five
days, your honest opinions will help us understand the recent
rise of socialism and develop our strategy to reach and teach
increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

We hope
to hear from friends representing every part of the country.

Education
is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your
partnership with Hillsdale College is critical.

As
Winston Churchill said, "Socialism is the philosophy of failure,
the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy."

If you
agree, please represent your state and take the National Survey
on Socialism today.

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/

Despite
the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember-it is
NEVER too late to defend liberty through education.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Peter, big news. Steve Scalise is coming to Maine to help kick-off the campaign against Jared Golden.
You know Steve Scalise. He is our U.S. House Republican Whip, our possible future Majority Leader if our Republicans win control of Congress this year. name: Shamaine Daniels
subject: Will you do this for my father?
body:
www.danielsforcongress.org [www.danielsforcongress.org]
My father brought us to this country to escape the kind of political chaos that took place on January 6th. I'm honoring my father, and my oath, by running against insurrectionist Scott Perry, and I'm asking you to join me [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/99379/images/Shamaine%20Dad.jpeg]
This past Sunday, as we celebrated Father's Day, I thought a lot about my own father, who passed away in 2014. One of our last conversations was about his fear that the same love of corruption and acceptance of totalitarian rule that devastated his country was rapidly infiltrating American politics.
He didn't live to see January 6, 2021, and so he didn't witness events that he had seen so often in our native country take place here on U.S. soil.
In some ways, I am relieved he didn't live to see that. I have those same fears, and I cannot sit back and watch our country become what my family came here to escape. That's why I'm running for Congress.
When I became an American Citizen, I swore to defend our Constitution from all enemies foreign and domestic. Will you help me keep my oath by supporting my campaign to defeat Scott Perry? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
Anyone who has witnessed totalitarianism up close, or who knows those who have, will tell you that when politicians are allowed to behave in ways they themselves know are unlawful but expect that their friends in high places will protect them from being held accountable, we have reached levels of corruption that should frighten every one of us.
My father would be proud that I am running for Congress. He would be even more proud that I am doing so to stand up for the the freedoms that meant so much to him because he knew what it was like to lose them.
Will you help me stand up for Democracy by making a contribution to support my campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
Defeating Scott Perry won't be easy, but we have no choice. We MUST do better than Scott Perry if we're going to protect our country and the Democracy that means so much to every American. I hope everyone had a wonderful Father's Day Weekend with their families, and I thank you in advance for helping me to honor my own father.
With Gratitude,
Shamaine
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/99379/images/PaidForByDanielsForCongressB.jpg]
Daniels For Congress
2018 N. 3rd Street
Harrisburg, PA 17102

Hello,
My opponent Chuck Grassley recently told voters at a town hall that he doesn’t “know much about guns.” He said he hasn’t shot one in twenty, forty, or even fifty years. But he won’t support any new federal gun laws.
As a three-star admiral who served 36 years in the U.S. Navy, I __do__ know quite a bit about guns... and I can tell you unequivocally that firearms like the AR-15 are weapons of war.
Senator Grassley, you've taken hundreds of thousands of dollars from the gun lobby. Just a few weeks ago, they named you Legislator of the Year. Because two days after 4 more kids were murdered in Oxford, Michigan, you stood up in the Senate and you blocked a bill requiring universal background checks.
You have no idea what an assault rifle is capable of. How powerful it is. How deadly accurate it is. What it does to a body. Yet you think any 18 year old should be able to walk into a gun show and buy one from a private seller, no questions asked.
[**Here’s my challenge to Senator Chuck Grassley: Come to a gun range with me.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46764186/351674520/-2086333777?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTc2NjcwZi02MmYxLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Q-4NBJKD13rIaqbu8Q0qzoK6EfRYoke1rMEajt0TJpA=&emci=d6d2e333-24f1-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=9976670f-62f1-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=6371843)
Pull the trigger of an AR-15. Feel the power. Watch what it does to a hard cantaloupe. See how fast you can shoot 30 rounds and load another 30-round magazine with just a bit of practice.
See how it shoots through doors, most body armor, even plaster walls. How that little itsy bullet flies along without a conscience for over a mile... and if your sight isn’t faulty, will kill a person accurately from 800 yards away.
**_Then_ tell me you don't agree with 90% of Americans that Congress needs to pass responsible gun ownership laws so we can finally stop these mass killings.**
I know these guns. I know why they don't belong in our communities. And before Chuck Grassley once again blocks a bill requiring even just a background check to buy one, he needs to see for himself what they’re capable of.
Just name the time and place. I'll be there.
Mike Franken, U.S. Navy (ret.)

subject: RINOs Betray 2nd Amendment

body:
Peter,

Do you know how to tell when Washington politicians are coming for your guns? It's when they promise they're not.

It's the same old dance.

Step 1: A murderer attacks a soft target.
Step 2: Liberals blame guns.
Step 3: Liberals lie about what they want.
Step 4: Liberals try to take our guns.

With the news of a new "bipartisan" gun deal, we're in Step 4.

Support the Senate Conservatives and stop the gun grabbers!

The media says "talks" are ongoing in the Senate. But we all know that those "talks" will end with an attack on the Constitution and our God-given rights.

Let's be clear. Liberals think they should be protected by guns, but your family shouldn't be. They talk a big game, but really their only problem with firearms is that conservatives have them.

Stand up for the Second Amendment by supporting pro-gun Senate candidates across the nation!

Uvalde was a tragedy. But it showed exactly why we cannot wait for the government to protect us! In times of crisis, we have to do it ourselves - and the Second Amendment guarantees our right to.

The 2022 election is make-or-break for the Second Amendment. Democrats are only one or two votes away from nuking the Senate filibuster to pass their gun control, amnesty, federal election takeover, and critical race theory mandates. But
every conservative victory - against Democrats in November and establishment Republicans in primaries this summer - is a step toward freedom.

SCF is the only organization committed to supporting principled conservatives against Republicans and Democrats to win the U.S. Senate - not for a party, but for our people.

Please join us and help defend your country and our rights.

The Swamp may be coming for our guns, but with your help, SCF is coming for them.

Sincerely,

Mary Vought
Executive Director
Senate Conservatives Fund

clean_body: Our campaign is garnering attention all over the state, but when you’re going up against the political establishment, you’re always the underdog. | = | Peter, I’m emailing to let you know that there are only four short weeks — 28 days! — until our Primary Election, and it’s all hands on deck as we head into the “get out the vote” phase of this election. In the last few weeks, we’ve seen a massive surge in momentum following the poll that put our campaign just one point behind frontrunner Peter Franchot. We’ve racked up endorsements from huge statewide organizations, from Our Revolution to Sierra Club MD to Pro-Choice Maryland Action to, most recently, Sunrise Maryland. But we can’t get complacent — with just four weeks left, we need to build on this momentum and keep going! = Our campaign is garnering attention all over the state, but when you’re going up against the political establishment, you’re always the underdog. That’s why in these next critical weeks, we need your help to keep our ads up on TV and share my story and vision for Maryland with more undecided voters. This campaign is fueled by grassroots donations, so I’m humbly asking for your support today — = | = = = With your support, we can bring lasting change to Maryland: committing to net-zero emissions by 2035, protecting LGBTQ+ folks of all ages, and building world-class schools committed to inclusion and achievement for every student. We really can win this, Peter, but we’re going to need everyone to chip in to make it happen. Please, give what you can today — every dollar makes a difference! Team,
It’s hard to believe it, but we’re almost halfway through 2022!
With a brand new district to run in, I’ve been out on the road almost constantly. Today, I thought it would be fun to show you some of what we’ve been up to recently, and share some of my takeaways from getting to know MI-07!

The lessons learned from each of these? Showing up in our communities, especially our smallest communities, matters. Back in 2020, I won in the town of Clarkston by 29 votes – because I showed up, I listened, and I followed through. While a parade or special event may be the most obvious place to show up, it is part of a much larger effort to get to know people and then fight for what they need in D.C. and Lansing.
All of this – the friendraisers, the parades, and the organizing on the ground – is only possible because of the grassroots support you’ve shown me over the past 6 months. The cost of hosting campaign events, purchasing and distributing yard signs, hiring staff to organize volunteers, and everything else that it takes to run a successful campaign quickly adds up . And we would not have been able to have such a presence in the new district if not for the folks chipping what they can, when they can to this campaign.
Now, we’re going to really kick things into high gear. We have a little over a month until the August 2nd primary, and then it will be off to the races – everything I’ve described in this email x10!
In order to win this seat in a tough year I need your help. Anything you’re able to contribute goes right back into showing up and connecting with the people in the new 7th. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220621&amount=28]

Elissa

These next few days will determine whether we prevail as one united America First movement or allow weak, establishment RINOs and unhinged socialists destroy our country. **This is the most critical moment of the race. Stand with me. Encourage your friends, family, and neighbors to join us.** Together, we can bring America First values back to Washington and __**TAKE BACK OUR COUNTRY**__. God bless,

I am honored to announce that once again, I have received EMILY’s List’s endorsement! As a fierce fighter for representation in politics and a woman’s right to choose, this endorsement means the world to me. = As the cofounder of the National Network to End Domestic Violence, I spearheaded the bipartisan effort to pass the Violence Against Women Act in 1994. Then, as a member of Congress, I was an active member of the pro-choice caucus and Chair of the Democratic Women in the House, where I fought day in and day out to protect funding for high-quality and affordable access to healthcare. And it’s a fight I won’t give up — one of my top priorities will be to expand access to reproductive healthcare, no matter their income level or insurance coverage. Now, I look forward to working with EMILY’s List to ensure Maryland’s Fourth Congressional District has a fierce advocate for women’s rights in Washington. = | | = | = | = | = | | Thank you, Donna | | | Congresswoman Donna Edwards is a proven progressive leader and a fighter with the clout and experience to deliver for Maryland’s 4th Congressional District from day one. Maryland is home to nearly 150,000 workers employed by the federal government. They make up a critical part of our state’s economy, and as Governor, I’ll proudly be their champion and advocate.

I’ll proudly partner with unions like AFGE to make it happen.
We’re just weeks away from the July 19 primary, and our people-powered movement continues to gain momentum as we enter the final stretch of this competitive primary race. Dear Friends –

It is with great hope for Alaska's future that I have decided to end my campaign to become Alaska's next Congressman. There are two outstanding Alaska Native women in this race who would both serve our state well, and I encourage my supporters to stay engaged and consider giving their first-place vote to whichever of them best matches their own values.

This race has been both exhausting and exhilarating. I appreciate all of you that donated to the campaign, wrote letters to the editor on my behalf, worked as co-chairs, put-up yard signs and attended sign-waving rallies. Thank you so much for your support. Trust that I am making the right decision.

I am a lifelong Alaskan with a passion for this state and its people. I know that polarizing partisanship is not how solutions are achieved. It takes leadership and work. Unfortunately, Alaska and America are stuck right now, and Monica and I have decided it is just too hard to run as a nonpartisan candidate in this race. I still believe that when people with differing opinions listen to each other and work together, problems get solved. Maybe we can reach that place sometime in the future. I hope we do.

Right now, our country is broken- inflation is out of control and partisan gridlock and grandstanding keeps decisive action at a standstill. My goals were:
* To bring fiscal common sense to Washington and reign in government spending to control inflation.
* To expand Alaska's energy sector including renewable energy, oil and gas, and lower the cost of energy in Alaska, and promote America's energy independence.
* To fortify Alaska's role in the Arctic to defend against aggressors like Russia and China, and to use our strategic position to deliver jobs and infrastructure.
* To deliver on healthcare and pharmaceutical cost reform and to make healthcare more affordable and accessible through a public option. And to work towards the broader goal of a government public health care system that is available to everyone who wants to buy into it, while still preserving the private health care system for those who desire to pay more for extra benefits that a public system might not provide.
* To work to diversify Alaska's economy to include a broader range of value-added industries.
* To advocate for access to high-speed internet and transportation and infrastructure solutions to connect our communities to the goods and services they need.
* To be a strong voice for our subsistence culture and way of life and to fight for sustainable fisheries.
* To keep the government out of personal decisions, like the use of cannabis, gender identity, and our sexual and reproductive choices.
* To work to end dark money's influence on our politics and to always put your voice ahead of corporate money.

It's time to deliver for Alaska and our country, and I hope that your next Congressman or Congresswoman does that.

Thank you again for your support.

Respectfully,

Al Gross

BY THE EDITORIAL BOARD
CHICAGO TRIBUNE
The Republican primary for the 6th District features six candidates. Burr Ridge Mayor Gary Grasso says, in the wake of the mass
shooting at an elementary school in Uvalde, Texas, he’s open to a frank discussion on gun control. He doesn’t think teens should
have access to assault-style rifles, and suggests use of such weapons could be confined to gun clubs. “Background checks should
also be part of the discussion,” he told us. “I am willing to do what we have to do to keep our children safe.”

[http://email.mail.electoraladvantage.com/c/eJxtjs1uwyAQhJ_GHC0WjLEPHKKq6SHpz6WH9lKBWTAVjh1Dk6ZPX9xzpZV2pNmd-YaPYNX9D47v3_xLHgy_PYi7_Lo-kjgPm_f8dH07NuvlwH1055fbss87YhUwYcGRoBhljLYMAERPm1oiUOmGRoJDVmTV0EmHWGPEIc-rjtpe9Clrj_UwT2RULUfBtXU9cmM61wlgILkQPe-cpJSRqMacl1TxXcX2ZdIWU979PPuIeglpSyrGlHw62bWo_5i3A7RBl90ybaTRyFtoaAeSOe2Ecbb-XNCTVdnlGmIMqd3o_R9-afgFzGleuQ] Burr Ridge Mayor Gary Grasso
talks before a 6th Congressional District forum in Countryside on May 4, 2022. (Antonio Perez / Chicago Tribune)

Conversely, one of his opponents, Orland Park Mayor Keith Pekau, toes the NRA line. Speaking about Salvador Ramos, the 18-year-old
shooter in Uvalde, Pekau told us, “If in fact there was no history, if he was completely law-abiding, what’s going to solve that
particular problem — someone that just snapped?” We think there’s a lot more that can be done, starting with much more sensible
gun control. Also in the race is Orland Park lawyer Scott Kaspar, who wants to ban mail-in voting and early voting, Glen Ellyn
energy consultant Niki Conforti, and Robert Cruz and Catherine O’Shea, both of Oak Lawn. Grasso is endorsed.

Jun 13, 2022 at 5:00 am

clean_body: Chicago Tribune Editorial: Grasso is endorsed. [] BY THE EDITORIAL BOARD CHICAGO TRIBUNE The Republican primary for the 6th District features six candidates. Burr Ridge Mayor Gary Grasso says, in the wake of the mass shooting at an elementary school in Uvalde, Texas, he’s open to a frank discussion on gun control. He doesn’t think teens should have access to assault-style rifles, and suggests use of such weapons could be confined to gun clubs. “Background checks should also be part of the discussion,” he told us. “I am willing to do what we have to do to keep our children safe.” [] Burr Ridge Mayor Gary Grasso talks before a 6th Congressional District forum in Countryside on May 4, 2022. (Antonio Perez / Chicago Tribune) Conversely, one of his opponents, Orland Park Mayor Keith Pekau, toes the NRA line. Speaking about Salvador Ramos, the 18-year-old shooter in Uvalde, Pekau told us, “If in fact there was no history, if he was completely law-abiding, what’s going to solve that particular problem — someone that just snapped?” We think there’s a lot more that can be done, starting with much more sensible gun control. Also in the race is Orland Park lawyer Scott Kaspar, who wants to ban mail-in voting and early voting, Glen Ellyn energy consultant Niki Conforti, and Robert Cruz and Catherine O’Shea, both of Oak Lawn. Grasso is endorsed. Jun 13, 2022 at 5:00 am To see the story on the Chicago Tribune website click here [] Request a yard sign! | Friend,

---
| | Peter,

Last week, our race against Tim Walz was rated a ["Toss Up"](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=062cea3640&e=33b11688c1) by RealClear Politics! This week? Tim Walz changed his mind on the tax surplus, and now apparently wants to [give half of it back](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=caa248a870&e=33b11688c1). **Besides dwindling poll numbers, what's changed?**

You know what Matt Birk and I want to do? Permanent, long-lasting tax cuts and giving back all of that money back to Minnesotans! That "surplus" is an over-taxation and should be treated as such. We're in a time of record inflation, out-of-control gas prices, and Minnesota families struggling to find baby formula and basic supplies. _Permanently growing government should _not_ be a priority._

Tim Walz is trying to hide from his record and use political gimmicks to win votes. **It won't work!** Minnesotans are smarter than that.

Peter,
On Friday, June 18, The US Food and Drug Administration gave emergency use authorization for both the Pfizer/BioNTech and Moderna Covid-19 vaccines for young children.
This is devastating news.
Most parents are wary of vaccinating their kids, and with good reason.
According to an April Kaiser Family Foundation's Vaccine Monitor survey of parents with children under 5, 27% said they would "definitely not vaccinate," 38% said they would "wait and see," and 11% said they would vaccinate their young children "only if required."
---
---
The survey results are unsurprising, because most children who are infected with Covid-19 only develop mild illness. In fact, according to the Mayo Clinic, 50% of infected children are asymptomatic.
As of now, the vaccines are not mandatory, but we know how quickly that can change.
Let me be clear: I am against mandatory negative Covid-19 PCR tests or vaccine mandates or passports.
While I personally believe it is a horrible idea to give these vaccines to children because of possible vaccine injury, I also believe it is your right, as parents, to make medical decisions for your children.
The Government does not get to force Moderna & Pfizer vaccines on your little ones to enrich these pharmaceutical companies.
Recently, I along with the 4 other candidates on the ballot, were invited to debate at the Chamber of Commerce policy conference on Mackinac Island. The Chamber required proof of vaccination or a negative PCR test for anyone attending the indoor conference, but not for those taking part in the debate, which was held outside.
I am the only candidate who declined to participate in that conference because I refuse to support any event that requires vaccine mandates.
Here is the official statement I released:

---
Peter, if you elect me as governor, on day one, I will cancel all vaccine and mask mandates.
How would you like to help elect a governor who will fight to protect your Constitutionally-protected, God-given rights?

Today, Tuesday, June 21st, is the Virginia Primary and I want to make sure you cast your ballot to shape a future that works for everyone!
🗳If you are voting in-person , polls in Virginia are open from 6:00 AM to 7:00 PM so make sure to follow through with your plan to vote TODAY if you haven't already.

🗳If you need to return your absentee ballot , you can drop it off at your local registrar's office by 7:00 PM TODAY, or drop it off at your post office to make sure it is postmarked TODAY.
Lastly, I want to say how incredibly humbled I am of the campaign we've built. Together, we built a diverse coalition in Virginia's 8th who are ready for representation that reflects our lived experiences. No matter what happens, I know that our grassroots movement will continue to fight and make your voice heard.
Your support means everything. Thank you!
Victoria

| | Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: "When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?" This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a "Great Reset" of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College's digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as "'capitalism with Chinese characteristics'--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below." Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zdde4405ar11p5e36f8qgqlarg7e4hf0r52dmju8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j68ob4cph2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left's "long march through the institutions"--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale's work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That 's why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, "Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy." If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zc5llompt7cks8nj15vh68nrlhlm80mk77ps3uvg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j68ob4cph2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

OSWEGO, Ill. (June 21, 2022) - Today, Kendall County Board Chairman, Scott R. Gryder, frontrunner for nomination of the Republican Party to challenge Lauren Underwood for Illinois' 14th Congressional District released his closing message to voters as they prepare to head to the polls on June 28.
Gryder's ad, titled, "We've Paid Enough," is an encapsulation of the hardships working families face daily while in the grip of the Biden-Underwood economy.
Upon public debut of his closing ad, Gryder released the following:
"My campaign kicked off with a commitment to meeting residents across the 14th District to listen and learn about ways in which we could improve the lives and outcomes of everyday people. Since then, countless individuals have shared deep concerns about their future, and the safety and security of their loved ones, friends, and neighbors who are struggling to get ahead in the worst economy our nation has faced in over 40 years.
Families have shared the anxiety of being forced to choose between putting food on the table and filling their gas tanks to get to work. Small business owners on main street are worried about keeping their doors open due to rising costs, supply shortages, and costly government regulations. Seniors on fixed incomes are worried about the skyrocketing cost of living, especially for medicine and rent.
During all of these conversations, I consistently hear the need for a change in direction and I agree. We need new leadership that will stand up for the hard-working families of Illinois 14th District and fight to end the failing policies of Joe Biden and his congressional ally, Lauren Underwood, backed by out of touch radicals like Nancy Pelosi. We need change, not more of the same, and change begins when we retake the 14th District to send a proven leader with a pro-growth, pro-family, pro-freedom record of accomplishment to Congress."
Currently serving as Kendall County Board Chairman, Scott Gryder is challenging Lauren Underwood for the future of Illinois 14th District on behalf of the hard-working people he meets every day who need relief from far-left activist government. name: John Fetterman
subject: seriously!?
body:
This makes me roll my eyes. 🙄🙄
POLITICO just reported that the Mitch McConnell aligned super PAC “Senate Leadership Fund” has already reserved $24 MILLION in ads in Pennsylvania.
That’s like, way more than we’ve raised during this entire race. And they're not raising that $25 at a time, day by day. They're just getting giant checks from unnamed, ultra-rich donors.
That really sucks!
Like, seriously? If you’re Mitch McConnell and you see our campaign’s hard-won grassroots strength, you just ring up your super PAC and pour $24 million into PA, and you can change the stakes of the race???
I know I’ve asked each + every one of you for a lot lately. It’s expensive to run a campaign like ours. But I’ve never needed support more than right now. We don’t take a cent from corporate super PACs, so it’s up to US to stand up to the GOP’s unlimited dark money.
Will you make your best donation — maybe even $10 or more — today to help us fight back against the GOP’s super PACs? Here’s the best link to give: [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20220621_CGVA_Fetterman]
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20220621_CGVA_Fetterman [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20220621_CGVA_Fetterman]

DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20220621_CGVA_Fetterman&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20220621_CGVA_Fetterman]
I hate how much money is in our politics these days. But in order to win on the issues we care about, I need to be able to respond to the record-shattering hauls of money coming our way.
If you trust me with a donation today, I promise I will fight like hell for you in the U.S. Senate. 🙏
Thank you for sticking by me. It means a lot to be surrounded by so many good people through the good and bad times. I really couldn’t do this without you.
John Fetterman
Lt. Governor of Pennsylvania

body:

It is a shame that in this day and age there are still people who want to erode women’s reproductive rights. | | [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDC3-DK4Z78BRJqQKESaXaqjR8g2RJbFZQPvOLZMonjmwwLaTvtIsRc9b3mz_v5zeVjvJyUBtDswpd9ghucsaeerHuh0Ad6BikFa9BD_ePI-TczjSPexCsakQ1MD1MAREQZNazeSWzhdzPtWqmTMvD79EYVoao7nzPl5kMBphlK9lkJmcpJMT3TWDDxufQCgiDg8MIpcqV9phL3lQLyB9CR0k8B2Q9AFrL3XG1NpUcByg1rr5kLRWQ4Qs4NwrlqsnH83rbdTXK9B5_5YfB48pX6M/3n3/kZ5imdjfRX2lNwWpPr39Dg/h0/0OEeNktqEfuL1-ot4iUm1TRgVeKL2tBdCdm1aD0f0IA)

Friend, This week, the Supreme Court will likely reverse over half a century of constitutional rights. It is a shame that in this day and age there are still people who want to erode women's reproductive rights. The decision upheld in Roe vs Wade has been settled law for over 50 years, but Republicans rigged the judicial system so they could undermine an established constitutional right. We must be ready to fight to protect women's rights to choice. This is a battle that we didn't ask for, but it's one that I am prepared to take to Congress. It is time that we codify Roe and act to secure women's rights permanently. A woman's right to choose is between her and her doctor. Byron Donalds and his fellow Republicans disagree. They are trying to regulate a woman's body autonomy and strip away rights that are not theirs to strip away. I was just announced as one of the first women endorsed by Women United for Florida, an organization which works to uplift women in Florida. I'm going to Congress to protect all Americans from having their rights stripped by the government. I'll do whatever it takes to keep Republican men from taking away women's rights .

That is why I fully support codifying Roe vs Wade at the federal level and will work in congress to enact legislation protecting a woman's right to choose in the likely event Roe is overturned in the upcoming weeks. body:
Today, the average gas price in Ohio is now $5.04 per gallon — a new record. But instead of proposing policies to support working families and diversify our energy sources, Max Miller is pointing fingers at Democrats. | |
---
Peter, Today, the average gas price in Ohio is now $5.04 per gallon -- a new record. ** ** But instead of proposing policies to support working families and diversify our energy sources, Max Miller is pointing fingers at Democrats. ** ** It's much easier to point fingers than make a plan yourself. Here's what Max Miller has said so far about our gas prices: ** ** ❌ He rails against infrastructure packages that would expand affordable alternatives to driving-to everyone's benefit ** ** ❌ He doesn't support investments in renewable energy and green jobs. ❌ He opposes $15/hour minimum wage, which would offer a cushion for folks to afford temporarily higher prices.

Many factors are impacting prices at the pump, but there's also a lot we can do at the federal level to control prices. We can release more oil barrels from our reserves. We can offer tax breaks for small businesses and working people, giving folks more money in their pockets during tough times. We can create local career pipelines so folks aren't commuting 50 or 100 miles for decent-paying jobs. We can raise the minimum wage so people can afford the current high gas prices. Max Miller won't do any of these. I'm ready to fight to put these ideas into action in Washington as your next Congressman. * At 17, I enlisted in the Navy and served six years planning and executing the deployment of Tomahawk Land Attack Missiles.
* I attended Syracuse University Law School on the G.I. Bill.

I believe that maxim still rings true today, and that’s why I’m asking you to send a few dollars to my campaign if you can.

For Country,

Rod Dorilás

| _**ABOUT ROD**_

Rod Dorilás is the first-generation son of two immigrants from Haiti. His father immigrated to Florida to pick crops, and eventually his parents went on to own a small business. From a young age, his parents instilled in him the importance of hard work, integrity, and service.

At age 17, Rod enlisted in the United States Navy, serving for six years as a Petty Officer Second Class and Assistant Engagement Control Officer onboard the USS The Sullivans, stationed in Jacksonville. There, he was responsible for planning and executing the deployment of Tomahawk Land Attack Missiles on the Ballistic Missile Defense destroyer.

Upon completion of his military service, Rod attended law school at Syracuse University with the help of the G.I. Bill. After graduating, he served in President Trump's Administration in the U.S. Department of Commerce. While serving our great nation, Rod fought tirelessly to ensure that American families and businesses weren't taken advantage of by China.

Rod is a true public servant and is dedicated to serving his country and community. He wants to ensure that every American, through hard work and perseverance, can achieve the American Dream. Rod is running for Congress in South Florida to continue Trump's America First Agenda and defend our country from the Radical Left.

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zup5554iksuukp47rifbk5los9g48vvjif082ce0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zf15bbeu2k8as6rt7j5lbgvnsq51bfe3q4oe2eqg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zt20efglpr15t42anlvvl9uvukq4egdtbp35ikvo_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2mcm7kbdu4d8b1lfisnpq0cvd0ikra4okb4mgcg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z524fcid6v9ue2jrntm7hom9olkthqtpoqgpshko_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zcfqib1sc744okusnqa7i42kcqh4fr5julgc7mfo_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zavav9grsh940gej9i4m6a3l6h099st9o31shskg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zksb8vspjnpo39lo0e2bauroilp1sp7h3s757ka8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z93r29pnfla9rpj42295bn43vp9rpmgqj1hhm498_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7a0uds5nqn24gb0nds00r42i3vt2pncmb0ks6h0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7iv7sjpe5b1uq58l5s81vov8i2gn0r4ormg5fug_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za1ec4fanf43nojci0hh7vpnmsbdllso7md90okg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmfr8qp0d2qdrj09llf7vpb0137c5qm15a1sq1d0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zb9p52h2gq44n36tdl20v5tnvcbcil9qvl49f6i0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zi87ksdmp1lbu8c32amn3gkh5ag94jp7kv46q1to_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za1ljt926nv0glpc9n8cil2rivbs6t4q0pmd69qg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrgpni1jgu5unirg1to8ot6qqlgppr9e1i8qii6g_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob4cth2bs)

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

name: Marjorie Taylor Greene
subject: All hands on deck emergency
body:
This is the biggest assault on gun owners in American history and will END gun ownership as we know it.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zm1n2baio7efk181qu2thv0cof6hv1sr96b68mig_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob2cjh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbob8tjkepi38oj3clj7eo32m9r36srlehgb2p1lmtijcpj0clgmasrkeho78t1gcv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i6lj3coljc9jr4cj66aob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp2bs)
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zu8o022qe2h7i0ciufk3k513kamc3akcd5efra7o_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob2cjh2bs)

Fellow Patriot,

This is an all-hands-on-deck emergency.

**Led by Mitt Romney, 10 RINO sellouts in the Senate just stabbed us in the back.**

[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z09lr2jplkjma6olm4qq645nlilbh34aqjmegb08_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob2cjh2bs)
These traitors just caved to Communist Democrats and supported red flag confiscation orders.

**The Second Amendment is under attack, and I need to know if you stand with me in the fight to defeat this unconstitutional and un-American gun grab.**

**[STAND WITH MTG AGAINST
JOE BIDEN'S GUN CONTROL
CHIP IN TODAY](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zi3qjprcbcqrf775ipjiavbt2175qn0mpl3fpllg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob2cjh2bs)**
**Red flag confiscation orders will allow gun grabbers to cherry-pick friendly judges to issue orders demanding law enforcement seize American 's firearms with no due process of law.**

Joe Biden already smeared every Trump voter in America as a domestic terrorist and a white supremacist.

And Joe Biden's already torturing Trump supporters arrested for nonviolent crimes on January 6 by locking them up in solitary confinement in the federal gulag.

Red flag confiscation orders will allow gun grabbers to target anyone that opposes mask mandates, illegal immigration, or thinks there was voter fraud in the 2020 election for the seizure of their firearms.

**The Republican Party needs a drastic identity change for America to survive.**

And that's why it's vital to elect America First conservatives that will fight every effort by Joe Biden to shred our God-given right to keep and bear arms.

**[So please chip in a contribution of $10, $25, $50, $100, or $250 and help me rally America First conservatives to stop this gun grab.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zmu8hns0gbbe585ihobvsl11jpuv7uqnd2l7881o_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob2cjh2bs)**
**[HELP MTG STOP THE GUN GRAB
DONATE TODAY](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z2tpbb34a8bhuthe8ic9kjljhh8e4egpcnjratd0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob2cjh2bs)**
**Together we can save the 2nd Amendment and defend our God-given rights. The fight is too important to give up.**

And I won't give up.

I didn't give up when they threw everything they had at me in the primary.

And it wasn't easy.

**George Soros-style dark money groups filed a lawsuit to RIP my name off the ballot.**

Liz Cheney allies and Never Trump Super PACS dumped millions of dollars into a smear campaign against me.

They depleted our bank accounts with their attacks.

I had to spend everything I had fighting attempts to kick me off the ballot, paying legal fees, and running a campaign against a RINO primary opponent.

**But this fight, the fight to defend our 2nd Amendment, defend our very constitution, is simply too important to ignore.**

That's why it's absolutely vital I have your support now.

And why I hope you will stand with me in this fight.

**[I hope you will join me in fighting to stop this dangerous attack on the Second Amendment by chipping in a contribution of $10, $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or $2,900 right away.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z8hket3807h5it1nell157l9ltimupc3f1uic1c0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob2cjh2bs)**
**[HELP MTG FIGHT BACK
CHIP IN TODAY](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2za82n6gbnajdnat6g75smenoqccj1004blam1smo_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob2cjh2bs)**
**Parents are burying their children, and the gun-grabbers seized on the tragedy to gut the Second Amendment.**

And RINOs like Mitt Romney is rolling over and supporting red flag confiscation laws.

Red flag confiscation laws are just the first step.

Now that Democrats see how weak establishment RINOs like Romney, Lindsey Graham, and John Cornyn won't put up a fight to defend the Second Amendment, their thirst to disarm the public will not go away.

**A national gun registration database and a ban on so-called "assault weapons" are up next on the menu.**

That's why I'm drawing the line here.

I won't back down.

I won't give an inch.

**_And I won 't surrender._**

Protecting the Second Amendment is just too important.

There is still time to stop this gun grab, but I can't do it without your help.

**That 's why it's vital you [chip in a contribution of $10, $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or $2,900](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z3dav5stqdc05nth0ub4nbk7p64117fkjpv62l8o_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob2cjh2bs) so I can lead the fight to defend the Second Amendment and kick the RINOs out of Congress.**
**[STAND WITH MTG
CHIP IN TODAY](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zjd5orhb9n63ooncvsfs30jfr9ngtqgs6kn1t3s0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob2cjh2bs)**

Yours in the fight,

**Marjorie Taylor Greene**
Congresswoman (R-GA)
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zk82h8he98jqnnfj9qj8a1610ru5nal1nsocbo4g_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j62ob2cjh2bs)

**_Greene for Congress, Inc.
3 Central Plaza #142
Rome, GA 30161

_**

body:
I’m counting on hearing from every single one of my supporters in order to help push us over the finish line.
Hey Fellow American,

name: Jared Moskowitz
subject: Celebrating Stonewall Pride in Ft. Lauderdale
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jared Moskowitz for Congress
body:
Dear Friends,

This past weekend, I was proud to march with LGBTQ+ leaders from across South Florida at Stonewall Pride in Ft. Lauderdale.

In the face of new attacks on the LGBTQ+ community, I know being a strong ally in the fight for justice is more important than ever.

But being an ally means more than showing up. It means standing up for what’s right. That’s why in Congress, I look forward to continuing Rep. Ted Deutch’s legacy of fighting for legislation that offers real protection and support to the LGBTQ+ community.

I’m tired of watching Republicans–and even some Democrats–in the Senate hold up the Equality Act. With Florida’s ‘Don’t Say Gay’ bill and a wave of anti-LGBTQ legislation nationwide, we need to codify these protections.

I’m looking forward to continuing that fight. I’m also going to champion the Connie and Ruthie bill, which provides protections for older LGBTQ+ Americans and has been a top priority for Rep. Deutch.

Together, we can and we will build a future where LGBTQ+ people are protected from discrimination, hate, and violence.

The vibrant energy at Stonewall Pride showed that even in the face of hate, our LGBTQ+ community remains strong and proud.

And like so many of you, I remain proud to be an ally.

Jared

| | | | | Dear Reader, |
---
Care to guess what the true inflation rate is today?
The government says it's 8.5% ... which is already bad enough, right?
But, if you calculate inflation the same way the government did in 1980, it's actually closer to 17%.1
The impact on the average retiree is not just dramatic. It's shocking.
For each percentage point increase in the inflation rate, the average retiree loses over $34,400 purchasing power.2
So even if the government's inflation estimate was accurate, we'd be talking about a loss of $292,000. And with 17% inflation, the loss mushrooms to **$584,000.**
This is no longer just a prediction of what might happen someday in the future.
It's happening right now as we speak. And it's getting worse by the day.
Fortunately, investors don't have to sit idly while the value of their hard-earned money vanishes before their very eyes.
There are some very simple and powerful ways to turn the tables on this crisis and transform it into a wealth-building opportunity unlike anything we've seen in four decades.
In his just-released video, our Weiss Ratings Senior Analyst, Sean Brodrick, explains exactly how.
If you [click here now](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv1v093631ouon1lok8jbgo1ullq74frlk8mo69o_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c3j61o34cdh2bs), it will begin playing on your screen immediately.
Good luck and God bless!
---

Fellow American,

A few years ago, I googled _'how to start a campaign'_.

I had no idea how to even start! And let me tell you something, I still have no clue what I’m doing.

But here’s what I do know... **_we can’t go on like this as a country._**

People can’t afford to drive to work. Kids are being used as political pawns. American energy is being suppressed. Our border is open. Babies are starving due to a baby formula shortage. **And our political 'leaders' are making excuse after excuse, without a single real solution.**

| Dear Peter, When we look around it's clear that our country is in crisis - from a broken border to skyrocketing inflation to failing schools. The status quo is simply unacceptable. **And yet our current representatives in Congress, folks like Mitt Romney and Blake Moore, continue taking the same old establishment approach that has failed us over and over again.** There's no sense of urgency or resolve to fight back. We need change. **I’m running for Utah’s 1st Congressional District because I believe it's time for bold America First leadership like Ron DeSantis is showing us in Florida.** We need to fight back harder especially on issues like election integrity, ending mandates, and parental rights in education. Simply put, it's time for Republicans to stop playing defense and go on the offense. It's time the government starts working for us the people, not the other way around. With the Supreme Court poised to overturn the 50-year precedent of Roe v. Wade, it's never been more important to protect reproductive rights on a federal level. As the only woman and mom in this race, I know just how important this is.

When the opinion leaked that showed the Supreme Court is preparing to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , I got a lot of messages from people worried about the privacy implications of the decision – and so I got to work on a bill to address it.

More and more red states are moving to criminalize abortion, which means private reproductive health data from period tracking apps and website search histories could be used to monitor and punish people who seek abortions.

Like millions of Americans, I use a period tracking app to track my cycle. When I learned that reproductive health data isn't protected and could be sold to third parties, I got mad – and I got to work.

**That is why I am introducing a bill to limit the reproductive health data that apps and websites collect, and protect what they do collect from being shared or sold.** The My Body, My Data Act will protect our information, protect our privacy, and reaffirm our rights to make our own decisions about our own bodies.

[_**I am proud that the Planned Parenthood Federation of America and NARAL support my efforts. Now, we need to show there is grassroots support for protecting reproductive health data by getting 5,000 signatures before Friday. Will you become a citizen co-sponsor of my bill today by adding your name?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46792729/351777325/214440455?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTMxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNGQ1YThhYi05OGYxLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GkFBrqJsiRPJ9Ytr-hBm-9_YusQNBzUlvoBelbpnga8=&emci=ced5a8ab-98f1-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=d4d5a8ab-98f1-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=14239920)

#
Derek, this is Susan Wild from Pennsylvania's 7th Congressional district. It is my great honor to represent Lehigh, Northampton, and Monroe Counties in the House of Representatives.
**[_In a moment, I’m going to ask you to contribute to our crucial campaigns,_](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220621-1?refcode=em20220621-6270&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6270_434096_4AAnHA&akid=6270%2E434096%2E4AAnHA)** but first, I’d love to tell you more about myself. In 2018 I flipped a seat from red to blue, becoming the first woman elected to represent this district. In 2020, I narrowly won against a self-funding Trumpian candidate in one of the closest House races in the country. And now, thanks to redistricting, I’m running for re-election in an even tougher district that experts are calling a total TOSS-UP.
**Pennsylvania is a critical swing state, and we know that both of our races will be two of the closest in the nation. But it’s not just Pennsylvania on the line — Democrats MUST win here if we’re going to hold the House and expand our Senate majority. Which is why I’m so proud to be supporting and sharing the ballot with my friend John Fetterman, who has a strong track record as an advocate for Pennsylvanians.**
**[_Can I count on you to rush a split contribution of $5 or more right away to ensure John and I have the resources to reach every last Pennsylvania voter and keep our state blue in the crucial midterm election?_](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220621-1?refcode=em20220621-6270&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6270_434096_4AAnHA&akid=6270%2E434096%2E4AAnHA)**
**[Chip In Now](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220621-1?refcode=em20220621-6270&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6270_434096_4AAnHA&akid=6270%2E434096%2E4AAnHA)**
In the House, we’ve passed life-changing bill after bill — from lowering prescription drug prices to raising the minimum wage to protecting a woman’s right to choose — but all of that progress has been stalled in the Senate. With so much at stake, we have to hold the House and expand our tie-breaking majority in the Senate.
I am proud to work every day for families and workers here in the greater Lehigh Valley and across the state and nation on the issues that matter most, like health care, infrastructure, and workforce development. And I know John shares my passion for advocacy and making sure working families can get ahead.
**We must keep Pennsylvania blue this November.[_If you’re with us, I hope you’ll make a split contribution today to keep John and me fighting for Pennsylvania families and workers._](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220621-1?refcode=em20220621-6270&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6270_434096_4AAnHA&akid=6270%2E434096%2E4AAnHA)**

Thankful for your support and to represent this great state,
Susan Wild
