_“Throughout his time in public service, Derek has made it his mission to protect all Kansans and ensure they have a shot at achieving their dreams. Bringing back a common-sense, conservative approach to the state is critical for its future. Best of luck to Derek Schmidt!”_ **U.S. Senator Tim Scott, South Carolina** _“I’ve known Derek Schmidt for a long time, and he’s always been a man of integrity, honesty, and had an incredible passion for serving Kansas. Working closely with him in our roles as attorney general and district attorney has provided me with the opportunity to see up close how dedicated he is to public safety and law and order. It was no surprise to see Derek out front leading on the issue of school safety recently with his strong plan to secure our schools and protect our children. It’s the type of solutions-oriented leadership that Kansas needs and that Derek will deliver day-in and day-out. I’m proud to support him in the race to be our next Kansas Governor.” _ **Johnson County District Attorney Steve Howe** _“Derek Schmidt is the leader that Kansas needs right now. He is pro-life, pro-Second Amendment, and he has successfully defended our values and freedoms that have been challenged unlike ever before these last few years. He will respect Kansans and trust us to lead our own lives without government interference and he will return our state to one that is pro-business and pro-family. Derek has my full support in November!” _**Kansas State Representative Brian Bergkamp** _"Derek Schmidt will make a great governor for Kansas. He has been a solid fighter for liberty and freedom and will be a governor who trusts parents and business owners, unlike our current governor. He and his pick for lieutenant governor Katie Sawyer will bring the right values to the governor's office and they have my full support!" _ **Kansas State Representative Tom Kessler** _"Derek Schmidt and Katie Sawyer are the right team to bring the positive, forward-thinking leadership that Kansas desperately needs. They will turn the page on the mistakes and missteps of the last few years and will bring the right values and experience to the governor's and lieutenant governor's office. I'm excited to endorse their candidacy and urge all Kansans to support them in November."_ **Kansas State Representative Cyndi Howerton** _“Attorney General Derek Schmidt has long been a steadfast supporter of law enforcement. I greatly appreciate all of his hard work and dedication to keeping Kansas communities safe as AG and know that he will bring those same values to the Governor’s office. He will put forth the right policies to help those of us in law enforcement continue to deal with the troubling rise in drug abuse and crime brought forth by poor leadership in Washington and a failure to secure our southern border. I am proud to endorse him in this race for Kansas Governor.”_ **Greenwood County Sheriff Heath Samuels** _“Derek Schmidt has never backed down from a fight against a government trampling our rights, whether it be Joe Biden in Washington or Laura Kelly in Kansas. We need his courage in leadership and we need him to bring Kansas conservative values to the Governor’s office. He’s proven throughout his time as attorney general and in this campaign that he’s got what it takes to win, and he’s earned my support.”_**Kansas State Representative Paul Waggoner**

Best of luck to Derek Schmidt!” U.S. Senator Tim Scott, South Carolina “I’ve known Derek Schmidt for a long time, and he’s always been a man of integrity, honesty, and had an incredible passion for serving Kansas. Working closely with him in our roles as attorney general and district attorney has provided me with the opportunity to see up close how dedicated he is to public safety and law and order. It was no surprise to see Derek out front leading on the issue of school safety recently with his strong plan to secure our schools and protect our children. It’s the type of solutions-oriented leadership that Kansas needs and that Derek will deliver day-in and day-out. I’m proud to support him in the race to be our next Kansas Governor.” Johnson County District Attorney Steve Howe “Derek Schmidt is the leader that Kansas needs right now. He is pro-life, pro-Second Amendment, and he has successfully defended our values and freedoms that have been challenged unlike ever before these last few years. He will respect Kansans and trust us to lead our own lives without government interference and he will return our state to one that is pro-business and pro-family. Derek has my full support in November!” Kansas State Representative Brian Bergkamp "Derek Schmidt will make a great governor for Kansas. He has been a solid fighter for liberty and freedom and will be a governor who trusts parents and business owners, unlike our current governor. He and his pick for lieutenant governor Katie Sawyer will bring the right values to the governor's office and they have my full support!" Kansas State Representative Tom Kessler "Derek Schmidt and Katie Sawyer are the right team to bring the positive, forward-thinking leadership that Kansas desperately needs. They will turn the page on the mistakes and missteps of the last few years and will bring the right values and experience to the governor's and lieutenant governor's office. I'm excited to endorse their candidacy and urge all Kansans to support them in November." Kansas State Representative Cyndi Howerton “Attorney General Derek Schmidt has long been a steadfast supporter of law enforcement. I greatly appreciate all of his hard work and dedication to keeping Kansas communities safe as AG and know that he will bring those same values to the Governor’s office. He will put forth the right policies to help those of us in law enforcement continue to deal with the troubling rise in drug abuse and crime brought forth by poor leadership in Washington and a failure to secure our southern border. I am proud to endorse him in this race for Kansas Governor.” Greenwood County Sheriff Heath Samuels “Derek Schmidt has never backed down from a fight against a government trampling our rights, whether it be Joe Biden in Washington or Laura Kelly in Kansas. We need his courage in leadership and we need him to bring Kansas conservative values to the Governor’s office. He’s proven throughout his time as attorney general and in this campaign that he’s got what it takes to win, and he’s earned my support.”Kansas State Representative Paul Waggoner Not a single season, month, or even day can go by without our full commitment to winning this election. body:
I have a plan to restore public safety in our country | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/50d9154282eb/i-am-running-for-congress-9132306?e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=bb4c7a3299&e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | Hi there,

Like you, I want our community to be safer — and I’m ready to do something about it. Today I’m proud to share my comprehensive safety plan: [Restoring Public Safety.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=7cde4c70da&e=356c0699dd)

**Crime has consistently remained at the top of lists of voter concerns, and if we truly want to address crime, we need to make a change in Congress this fall.** My opponent has no new ideas and lacks understanding of the challenges our brave first responders face, and why certain crimes happen in the first place.
---
| [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=dc8e0ec421&e=356c0699dd)
---
| We need an all–hands on deck approach to public safety. We need violence prevention in the community, we need stronger, better-trained law enforcement, and we need to be sure that our interventions are constitutional and, most importantly, unbiased.

**[My plan focuses on five, common-sense primary provisions:](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=b86f6e5088&e=356c0699dd) 1) investing in law enforcement; 2) a practical approach to gun safety; 3) better crime prevention; 4) criminal justice reforms, and 5) addressing Alcohol & Drug Addiction and Mental Health.**

This plan also includes provisions to confront gun violence, calls for the legalization of cannabis, and addresses racial and other disparities.
---
| [READ MIKE'S PLAN TO RESTORE PUBLIC SAFETY](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=65db2aba3e&e=356c0699dd "READ MIKE'S PLAN TO RESTORE PUBLIC SAFETY")
---
| We need to give our police the tools and training to succeed, and stop asking them to serve as mental health counselors and social workers. We can do better for our community and for those in law enforcement.

One of the best ways to reduce crime and restore public safety is to make sure the economy is robust and working for everybody, and that everyone has access to good quality, affordable health care, including mental health care.

**Simply put: we can do better to keep our families safe — and I plan on doing just that.** [I hope you’ll take a moment to check out my comprehensive plan to restore public safety](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=4e3d08e24c&e=356c0699dd) so we can move forward, together.

Thanks for reading,
Mike

body:
This comes at a time when members of Congress are considering whether or not to vote on the compromise gun safety bill.
#

Friends -
In just a few days, we close the books on an FEC fundraising deadline for Giffords PAC. Here’s why this is so important:
When this deadline ends, we’re required to report our fundraising numbers.
This comes at a time when members of Congress are considering whether or not to vote on the compromise gun safety bill.
Our numbers may be one of the last things they see before they are forced to decide.
And what we need to show is an overwhelming amount of grassroots support for commonsense gun safety laws.

body:

---
Folks, thanks to this grassroots team, the NDRC has accomplished a _lot_ since our founding in 2017. **But our work is far from over!**

That’s why we wanted to take a moment to show our top supporters where we’ve been over the past few years and where our work is headed next. If you’re ready to donate toward the next phase of our work, you can do that here: **_[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ndrc-stillinfight](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46795757/351793157/525551484?amount=20&refcode=20220621.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4NGNjMjFhLWE1ZjEtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=nf6RUoE3NVvjQqmxD_hJt_yD0mSSIzygvs8nBsUnJJM=)_** **The Victories** Throughout this redistricting cycle, the NDRC has led a comprehensive strategy to stop Republicans from gerrymandering their way into power. This involved supporting fair-maps Democrats in elections between 2017 and 2020, mobilizing communities to engage in advocacy, and, with our affiliates, supporting voters in lawsuits – _and it was a huge success_.

**As a result of our efforts, 75% of the states now have fair congressional maps** , and Democrats are in a _much_ stronger position than we were after the 2010 redistricting cycle. That’s worth celebrating! | [Donate to support the NDRC
as we work toward more victories](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46795758/351793164/525551484?amount=20&refcode=20220621.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4NGNjMjFhLWE1ZjEtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=nf6RUoE3NVvjQqmxD_hJt_yD0mSSIzygvs8nBsUnJJM=)
---
**The Challenges**
Despite our gains, Republican gerrymanderers have been _relentless_ in their quest to manipulate maps. Just look at the mess in Florida.

Originally, a judge _struck down_ Governor DeSantis’ gerrymandered map as an unconstitutional attack on the power of Black voters. **But the rigged map has since been put back into effect** , and Florida’s Supreme Court has declined to take action against it at this time.

This fiasco serves as a clear reminder of why the next phase of our work is so critical.
[Donate to help the NDRC
continue taking on map manipulators](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46795759/351793170/525551484?amount=20&refcode=20220621.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4NGNjMjFhLWE1ZjEtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=nf6RUoE3NVvjQqmxD_hJt_yD0mSSIzygvs8nBsUnJJM=)

**The Next Phase**
Because of where we’ve been, we know what we need to do next: **Help win the fight for fair maps.**

That’s why, for the next stage of our work, we’ve announced an initial slate of **Democracy Targets** where we’ll make investments to help **_elect_** pro-democracy candidates, **_defeat_** map-manipulating politicians, and **_stop_** the GOP from stacking state courts.

That’s why we wanted to take a moment to show our top supporters where we’ve been over the past few years and where our work is headed next. If you’re ready to donate toward the next phase of our work, you can do that here: = The Victories Throughout this redistricting cycle, the NDRC has led a comprehensive strategy to stop Republicans from gerrymandering their way into power. This involved supporting fair-maps Democrats in elections between 2017 and 2020, mobilizing communities to engage in advocacy, and, with our affiliates, supporting voters in lawsuits – and it was a huge success. As a result of our efforts, 75% of the states now have fair congressional maps , and Democrats are in a much stronger position than we were after the 2010 redistricting cycle. That’s worth celebrating! | = The Challenges Despite our gains, Republican gerrymanderers have been relentless in their quest to manipulate maps. Just look at the mess in Florida. Originally, a judge struck down Governor DeSantis’ gerrymandered map as an unconstitutional attack on the power of Black voters. But the rigged map has since been put back into effect , and Florida’s Supreme Court has declined to take action against it at this time. This fiasco serves as a clear reminder of why the next phase of our work is so critical. = The Next Phase Because of where we’ve been, we know what we need to do next: Help win the fight for fair maps. Friend,

As a physician, I've served thousands of patients across Southern California.

I often describe my practice as a revolving, one-on-one town hall. I treat physical ailments, but over time it's not hard to see bigger patterns emerge. There are a number of social and political issues that have contributed to an overall decline in our health and well-being.

Whether it’s the air quality triggering asthma symptoms, the lack of preventative health care keeping folks from seeking care earlier, or even extreme stress at home or work due to rising costs -- our community is facing serious problems. Lizzie was back home in Houston this past weekend, updating constituents on her work and answering questions from TX-07 neighbors.
She has been out and about at home lately, checking in with people across the district, as she promised she would — from celebrating PRIDE month to meeting people in areas that will be new additions to the seventh district, including Houston's International District.
https://secure.ngpvan.com/ubc8dDnnZ0ezopLxj-Sryg2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/ubc8dDnnZ0ezopLxj-Sryg2]
This past weekend, the Texas GOP held its convention in Houston where they approved an extreme agenda that included claiming without evidence President Biden’s 2020 victory was “illegitimate,” undermining Congress’ bipartisan efforts to address gun violence in our communities, and other anti-choice and homophobic measures.
“The actions capped a convention that highlighted how adamantly opposed the [GOP’s] most active and vocal members are to compromising with Democrats or moderating on social positions.”
- The Texas Tribune, 6/18/2022
The Texas GOP’s platform seeks to further divide us. Lizzie is working across the political divide to bring us together and get things done for Texas — like strengthening common sense gun-safety measures and protecting Texans’ — and all Americans' — access to reproductive care.
Moments like this are a reminder that this November, we need to elect leaders in Texas and across the country who are working to address our biggest challenges — not divide us.
https://secure.ngpvan.com/ubc8dDnnZ0ezopLxj-Sryg2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/ubc8dDnnZ0ezopLxj-Sryg2]
We’re asking members of #TeamLizzie to share their thoughts about the economy. We’ve already heard from many of you that going into the election, we need to talk to voters about how fast the economy is growing — from record job gains to rising wages. Lizzie is working to build on those gains and continue rebuilding and strengthening our economy, and we’re talking to TX-07 voters about her efforts.
We want to hear from you, too. Take a moment to fill out our survey and tell us your thoughts about the economy and how we should talk about it with voters this year. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/ubc8dDnnZ0ezopLxj-Sryg2]

subject: as honest as we can be
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY NEWSOM FOR CALIFORNIA – GOVERNOR – 2022
body:
Sometimes it takes a little explaining about why your donation to Gavin Newsom’s re-election is so important.

Friends -
Sometimes it takes a little explaining about why your donation to Gavin Newsom’s re-election is so important. So let us be as honest as we can be here.
Here it goes.
Is Gavin Newsom favored to win re-election this November? Yes.
Is his re-election guaranteed in what could be a tough year for Democrats? No.
Will we use your donation to turn out Democrats this November? Yes.
Will anyone turn out more Democrats than Gavin Newsom? No.
Will that help pass a constitutional amendment protecting abortion access in California? Yes.
Will it help push Dems in a few close races over the edge to victory? Yes.
The truth is, almost all of our donations come from people making individual donations. That’s how we fund the work. That’s how we keep California blue.
But it won’t happen unless we ask, and that’s what we have to do today:
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to Gavin Newsom’s re-election campaign today? Do it before our official fundraising deadline comes to a close at the end of the month.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gcn-em-june22?refcode=em-220621-1-30&refcode2=854_4767699_PJRWGQ&akid=854%2E4767699%2EPJRWGQ)

Peter -

With the conservative-majority Supreme Court set to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ at any moment, the task of protecting reproductive rights will fall to the states.

**But here in Wisconsin, an archaic law that bans and criminalizes abortion could take effect unless it is repealed immediately.**

Our Democratic governor has committed to not enforcing this law, but he’s up for re-election in November. Our right to reproductive freedom shouldn’t hinge on which party is living in the Governor’s Mansion, or the White House. Republicans control our legislature, and it’s time for them to set partisan priorities aside and REPEAL this cruel bill at tomorrow’s special session.

**The majority of Americans know that access to safe, legal abortion care is essential. We are that majority, and we all need to speak out with one voice and MAKE Republican legislators listen.**

Peter, Deb and her mother fought for _Roe_ in the 70s. She knows we cannot go backwards - or afford to wait a moment longer. The time to act is NOW.

subject: Colorado Broadcasters Endorse Erik Aadland
body:
Prominent Coloradans are stepping up
| | | |
---
|
---
|
# Ross Kaminsky & Richard Randall
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
(June 20, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from two Colorado radio personalities, Richard Randall and Ross Kaminsky.

Ross Kaminsky brings a fresh perspective to the news, politics, culture and everyday life on Denver's 630KHOW. While most of Kaminsky's career has been in financial markets trading, he has become involved in political media since college and in radio for the past decade, becoming one of the leading voices in Denver conservative talk radio.

"Erik Aadland stands clearly above the other CD7 candidates in terms of both fitness for office and electability," Kaminsky wrote in his [Colorado Primary Voter Guide.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001n39nXODGIsSDFWSXn4zjIy2TWbS70YhoK98MXeJtelLpUxTLv46za8EDpFTG1xERih1qPJXCArJYIZcVb50r2sLX1u2aQWHIJIT19L3QElFOGYhVSF41xqSA9-jQIrWh_byYqaucbnugSKR4D2NnawFh3vztQEPj1Efp1wPx73UScWey5gnIgTaSUa1e337ywIqSbol5OuflZJcyBhq83nuQVIBcqdz46I8N4VFxr9lwrH7vp3O3EyTnmvKetFcKk920bJIzwUf5OCgIzJbGgb7Bq2yjxXRbAsDvyEs2ochMiX571wVf0w==&c=GN_T8hzT7xYOuEpyt0B4jLkT8XWBInAf1fueMPxUV7UQiv1B8nqyqQ==&ch=rtLusgLNfx8MBxd9veqLqpcMICm694LE57qp05B5n64yyKChvPjsSQ==) "Erik strikes me as a man driven by service to his country, perhaps not surprising for a West Point graduate and decorated veteran. He also strikes me as a man who will not be co-opted by the usual people who buy the loyalty (or fear) of members of Congress. In short, Erik is, for me, the very model of a citizen legislator."
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
Richard Randall is heard every weekday on 740KVOR out of Southern Colorado. Randall began his broadcasting career in Illinois, where he also worked as a trial lawyer. After coming to Colorado Springs, Randall spent time as a reporter for KKTV before working in news and beginning his talk radio career at KVOR. Randall has also produced several television documentaries, including several for PBS. While at KVOR, Richard has hosted numerous community gatherings and informational sessions and is continuously sought out by politicians and political candidates.

"My first interaction with Erik showed he could roll with the punches," said Randall. "Erik's vast experience in the military and success in the private sector has fashioned him into a well-rounded, hardworking and impressively accomplished individual. I have no doubt Erik will make an extraordinary Congressman."
|
---
|
---
|
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "It is an honor to have two such outspoken and fearless radio personalities support my run for office. Both Randall and Kaminsky speak with sitting politicians and candidates nearly every day, they know what it takes to succeed. I am humbled by their endorsements and so grateful for their support on the radio. I look forward to calling into their shows when I'm a Congressman!"
---
---
| |
---
|
---
| | [Send Erik your feedback](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001n39nXODGIsSDFWSXn4zjIy2TWbS70YhoK98MXeJtelLpUxTLv46za1JWbqGHc9Jy_50bLELGjW9uPU08LgoY8rvN4cdTvSTWKiJNPTi-6Z96DP-9FElqUEx27dkjXMKLFrBPdOdIzSM5uJII1tyIX52dowDIO4wTABt7Zp6hs3wUCkFo-I-CuWHt_KUNlxjkEJKkj33EGh_Huvgh-PNEW0Sv6-F8B10NGlelNXmxnztgincyQw_GpNNxLrsaqLSt3Hlcyisy2wSt69DcVQQAPw==&c=GN_T8hzT7xYOuEpyt0B4jLkT8XWBInAf1fueMPxUV7UQiv1B8nqyqQ==&ch=rtLusgLNfx8MBxd9veqLqpcMICm694LE57qp05B5n64yyKChvPjsSQ==)
---
| |
---
|
## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
|
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

Friend -- We wanted to make sure you saw the great news about the Kenosha County Board taking the first steps to ban the use of outside private money to run elections. A recent **[](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=zN5gEYXLykR0kv-yDZpGDTl8hly2M9z-eJ7DrUxXZkmYOcF5jPKvEeX0hK2gbvS7CiUQQxVMO4C5nomigQ-BPhnA9urnhOgFW8vMLVcd0xo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_zuckerbucks_1&n=2)****[](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=zN5gEYXLykR0kv-yDZpGDTl8hly2M9z-eJ7DrUxXZkmYOcF5jPKvEeX0hK2gbvS7CiUQQxVMO4C5nomigQ-BPhnA9urnhOgFW8vMLVcd0xo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_zuckerbucks_1&n=3)****[](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=zN5gEYXLykR0kv-yDZpGDTl8hly2M9z-eJ7DrUxXZkmYOcF5jPKvEeX0hK2gbvS7CiUQQxVMO4C5nomigQ-BPhnA9urnhOgFW8vMLVcd0xo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_zuckerbucks_1&n=4)****[7-0 vote approved a resolution](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=zN5gEYXLykR0kv-yDZpGDTl8hly2M9z-eJ7DrUxXZkmYOcF5jPKvEeX0hK2gbvS7CiUQQxVMO4C5nomigQ-BPhnA9urnhOgFW8vMLVcd0xo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_zuckerbucks_1&n=5)** to prohibit the county from accepting non-government entities grants or funding intended for such use (i.e. "Zuckerbucks"). The entire board plans to vote on this resolution in the coming weeks. [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=zN5gEYXLykR0kv-yDZpGDTl8hly2M9z-eJ7DrUxXZkmYOcF5jPKvEeX0hK2gbvS7CiUQQxVMO4C5nomigQ-BPhnA9urnhOgFW8vMLVcd0xo&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_zuckerbucks_1&n=6) This is not the first county to take action. Walworth County was the first in the state to ban the use of private funding to administer elections when that board passed its policy [in April](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=VB47-dFNmBEqPXGQ3b087VAk0A-BTRqxPiwcDzz8j6nIJNDNXybFWdXTbHbhEAD6VwBaZe-DCrC667QnPMuUORkQcOoUmRtLS0lb39CkpDVGtTiGneyA9HT9TcotCn5Y0kgPOnRBPQrtGs97EMBnOXZxMInHa-Iuc0zcj1q4q-cnOLUMD8hS2qQpJ6aGvrgD&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_zuckerbucks_1&n=7).
* * *
These are the exact type of actions Conservatives can take at the local level to influence their county and municipal laws, especially in determining how our elections are run! The RPW worked tirelessly with our local county parties to recruit, train, and flip over 300 local races. **Many of those races were in Kenosha and Walworth!** This is a perfect example of how all this hard work turns into action. Friend, Republicans across Wisconsin are fired up to get rid of Tony Evers and Josh Kaul! To help us continue the fight at the local level, please consider contributing to our local government initiative fund so we can continue to work with our grassroots on these issues! | [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVEhIWMoAFHND7Yaq3LO6KJhT2uYYjdDfugTHBoST4TVU&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_zuckerbucks_1&n=8 "Contribute to Our Local Government Initiative") [Contribute to Our Local Government Initiative](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVEhIWMoAFHND7Yaq3LO6KJhT2uYYjdDfugTHBoST4TVU&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_zuckerbucks_1&n=8)

# NRA President David Keene endorses Scott Kaspar
Yesterday, I was honored to have David Keene, former President of the National Rifle Association (NRA) and Chairman of the American Conservative Union (CPAC) in the district for a thought-provoking roundtable discussion on how to reduce gun violence and increase school safety without infringing on our Second Amendment rights.

The Democrats continue their assault on the Second Amendment – and its crystal clear what their objective is: to disarm every American and take away the guns of every law-abiding citizen.

And I won’t allow it.

In Congress, I will stand up against Nancy Pelosi, Chuck Schumer and Joe Biden, and protect our Second Amendment rights.

To learn more about my campaign, please visit [www.kasparforcongress.com](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=2c6b3a8468&e=9931950ab1).

Peter, it's Trudy. I'm on the go in between campaign events, so I've only got a couple of minutes to spare, but I needed to reach out.
Thank you _so much_ for being one of my very first supporters. Because of your early and strong backing, our campaign has gotten off the ground with an incredible burst of grassroots energy.
Listen: Washington is broken, plain and simple. There's too much political bickering and not enough compassion. **We need leaders with a nurse's heart, who know that empathy, kindness, and doing right by the people who elected you is what matters.**
That's exactly why I'm running for Senate: I promise you as your senator that I'll listen to your concerns and put you first, every single time.
But to get to Washington, I'm counting on you to stand with me every step of the way. That's why I'm emailing you today: **Please, before my next deadline at midnight TONIGHT, can you make your first donation of $5 or whatever you can spare to elect someone who will fix Washington and who will lead with compassion and integrity? Armed with her faith and support from her Mother, Monica grew up to become one of the top insurance agents in South Texas. We need people like Monica in Congress. A woman who knows what hard work is; a woman who has the perseverance and grit to deliver for her community. Republicans only need to pick up FIVE seats next year to win back the House, and I can tell you that Monica’s race is one of the best chances we have at flipping a BLUE seat RED! On behalf of my friend Monica, – whatever that means to you. Monica will represent our entire Party in the House, and she’ll make us all proud. subject: Join me in urging Congress to lower inflation [PETITION]

body:
I was proud to cast my vote in support of the Lower Food and Fuel Costs Act.
Peter,

It's no secret that we're facing real concerns across the globe about rising inflation -- including here in America. Now that we're making our way to the other side of this pandemic, I know that many folks are still sitting at their kitchen tables trying to figure out how to make ends meet.

Last week, I was proud to cast my vote in support of the Lower Food and Fuel Costs Act -- a legislative package to lower prices for Washington families in the grocery aisle and at the gas pump. And I voted to support legislation that cut costs for families and small businesses while also boosting American exporters' ability to efficiently deliver products to the global marketplace.

Look, it's been hard to recover from this pandemic. These last few years have been the pits. But I will keep working every day to recover our economy and combat inflation for folks.

**[This legislation will lower costs on fertilizer, meat, poultry, and at the pump. body:
Dear Friend,

Our next Participate PA is just days away! Have you RSVP'd yet?

This time, we're taking on gun safety with a book talk and Q&A with former gun industry executive and current Giffords Senior Advisor, Ryan Busse. He'll be discussing his book "Gunfight: My Battle

Against the Industry that Radicalized America," an insider’s call-out of a dangerous industry — one that has shifted from prioritizing safety to fear. We need this valuable perspective now as the U.S. struggles with regular gun violence.

Don't miss out on this opportunity to come together with faith leaders, gun violence prevention advocates, and concerned citizens to build a safer Pennsylvania. [https://www.kpef.info/kpef-events/gunfight] The event is also hosted by Gun Owners for Safety, Center That CARES, Keystone Progress Education Fund, and Squirrel Hill Stands Against Gun Violence.

Thursday, June 23

Coughlin's Law Kitchen and Ale House, 10 Virginia Ave, Pittsburgh, PA 15211

RSVP TODAY! [https://www.kpef.info/kpef-events/gunfight]

Let's get talking!

Laura Nevitt

name: Admiral Mike Franken
subject: I will not stand silent
body:
Admiral Mike Franken is running for Senate to defeat Chuck Grassley in Iowa. Split a donation between his campaign and CommonGood today and do your part to protect our Democratic Senate majority. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvafranken?refcode=20220622_CGVA_Franken]
Derek,
Well, that didn’t take long. Less than an hour after I was declared the Democratic nominee for Senate in Iowa, the attacks from Chuck Grassley began:
*
“The
most
liberal
nominee
in
Iowa
Senate
history”
*
“Radical”
*
“Socialist”
Gotta love it! Chuck Grassley doesn’t know what to say about me. He’s never faced an opponent like me before. I’m his political nightmare, so he’s just throwing cow pies at the wall and hoping something sticks.
Calling me “radical” is laughable when Chuck Grassley supports a complete ban on abortion and letting literally anyone buy an AR-15 without even a background check.
But there’s one attack that I absolutely won’t take lying down, and that’s Chuck Grassley attacking me for serving our country for 36 years in the U.S. Navy.
Grassley is already trying to say that because I enlisted in the military at age 19, because my deployments meant that my family had to move from state-to-state and country-to-country... that I’m not an Iowan anymore.
Chuck Grassley wants to pretend that I wasn’t raised in rural, northwest Iowa. He ignores the enormous sacrifices that my family – my wife and my kids – made to allow me to serve in the Navy.
Grassley’s attacks denigrate every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, spend holidays away from each other, and be absent from life’s big events like weddings and the birth of a child.
And if Chuck Grassley thinks that I will stand silent while he says that every Iowan who puts on our country’s uniform stops being an Iowan... he’s delusional.
These are the kinds of attacks I’m going to be up against. Nasty stuff from Chuck Grassley, Mitch McConnell, and the Fox ‘Entertainment’ News propaganda network.
There’s one reason why: The GOP is scared. They’ve seen the polls, and they know that if we defeat Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, Democrats are guaranteed to maintain our Senate majority.
In order to fight back, we need to raise another $100,000 before midnight tomorrow, but the only way we’ll hit our goal and send Grassley packing is if grassroots donors like you give right now:
Please, can I count on you to split a donation of $25 or more right now between my campaign and CommonGood – every dollar you can afford – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvafranken?refcode=20220612_CGVA_Franken]

These attacks against me are ridiculous, but we cannot let them go unanswered.
Thank you for being a crucial part of this phase of our campaign,
Mike Franken, U.S. Navy (ret.)

name: =?utf-8?Q?Kelly=20Schulz?=
subject: Weekly Round Up!
body:
We are less than 30 days away from the July 19th primary! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/844cbbad9179/weekly-round-up?e=64ac72257a)
---
| |
---
| |
#
We are now less than 30 days away from the July 19th primary election and Jeff and I are crisscrossing the state meeting with Marylanders to share our vision for a safe, steady and prosperous future.

One of the highlights of the week was that we released our new ad, “These Guys.” The ad draws a clear contrast between myself and the other guys who are running for governor. I want to continue to move our state in the right direction, while they want to raise your taxes, take more control of your children’s education, and not seriously confront the violent crime crisis.
---
| [ ](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=f9a14215b0&e=64ac72257a)
---
| We spent last Monday through Wednesday on the Eastern Shore with stops and visits in Somerset, Worcester, Caroline and Queen Anne’s County. Lots of stops, but lots of fun and truly great experiences connecting with Marylanders from all walks of life.

In Somerset County we held two meet and greets at Squeaky’s Café and one at Hardwire following our tour of the facility.
---
|
---
| The Maryland Municipal League (MML) Conference was taking place in Ocean City, so we stopped by, met with local leaders, first responders, and participated in the MML gubernatorial candidate forum. I was the only Republican candidate on stage, and talked about how we will make communities safe, and how our administration would be a partner with communities across the state – from economic development and Main Street revitalization, to making sure that every student has a chance to succeed.
---
|
---
|
---
| Following great stops in Federalsburg and Denton with Federalsburg Mayor Kim Abner and Delegate Jeff Ghrist, we made our way to Stevensville for a packed house event, to cap off our great time on the Eastern Shore.
---
|
---
|
---
| While we were on the Eastern Shore, Jeff Woolford was meeting with Republican voters in Harford and Anne Arundel Counties. He finished the week at Juneteenth community events in Calvert and St. Mary’s Counties.
---
|
---
|
---
| Our weekend included a stop at the Muslim Citizens of Maryland candidate forum in Gwynn Oak and an event in Union Bridge, in front of a large and enthusiastic crowd that wants to keep moving Maryland in the right direction.

My grandson, Bo, even stopped by for that one! It was so great to see him out on the campaign trail.
---
|
---
|
---
| **Check out a few other highlights from the week:**
---
| Interview with Fox 45
---
| [ ](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=47408f2828&e=64ac72257a)
---
| Interview with MPT
---
| [ ](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=73c54a0847&e=64ac72257a)
---
| I was thrilled to have received the support of the Maryland Realtors PAC Trustee’s:
---
|
---
| Just a friendly reminder. The primary election is on July 19th, however, for those of you who requested ballots, they’re set to hit your mailboxes soon, if they haven’t already. Please make sure to send these back and have them postmarked by July 19th.

Additionally, early voting starts on July 7th and will run until July 14th.
---
| [ ](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=84f6aa78c0&e=64ac72257a)
---
| Thank you for your support,
---
|
---
| **Kelly Schulz**
Candidate for Governor

| | | Dear Peter,

Today on Capitol Hill, at the very site of a violent insurrection just 18 months ago, the _House Select Committee to Investigate the January 6th Attack_ is methodically laying out details to the American people about the horrific assault on our democracy – and the whole nation is watching.

Our democracy faces a clear and present danger from right-wing extremists in Congress and state capitals across our country. It’s more important than ever that we elect proven fighters to Congress with real-life experience passing laws that throw a safety net around our democratic process.

**Peter, when I am in Congress, I’ll never stop fighting to defend our democracy from those who ignore the will of the people and the rule of law.** [Can you help me get there with a contribution of $25, $50, or $100 today?](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=755da0ceca&e=292fde286a)

As California Assembly Speaker pro Tem, I authored the landmark _DISCLOSE Act_ , one of the nation’s toughest laws to ban dark money in our state elections. I passed the state’s first all vote-by-mail election, leading to record-breaking turnout and voter participation, and co-authored California’s groundbreaking automatic voter registration bill to make it easier for every Californian to participate in our democracy. That’s just one of the reasons why Congresswoman Jackie Speier honored me with her sole endorsement.

As our next member of Congress, I am prepared to be a forceful and effective voice for removing dark money from our elections, protecting everyone’s voting rights, and protecting the integrity of our elections from far-right insurrectionists and anyone else who seeks to subvert our democratic process.

[I’ll only get there with your help, ](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=ff56e7a9fd&e=292fde286a)[Peter](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=b1f6c27a34&e=292fde286a)[. Kevin Mullin

Care to guess what the true inflation rate is today?
The government says it's 8.5% ... which is already bad enough, right?
But, if you calculate inflation the same way the government did in 1980, it's actually closer to 17%.1
The impact on the average retiree is not just dramatic. It's shocking.
For each percentage point increase in the inflation rate, the average retiree loses over $34,400 purchasing power.2
So even if the government's inflation estimate was accurate, we'd be talking about a loss of $292,000. And with 17% inflation, the loss mushrooms to **$584,000.**
This is no longer just a prediction of what might happen someday in the future.
It's happening right now as we speak. And it's getting worse by the day.
Fortunately, investors don't have to sit idly while the value of their hard-earned money vanishes before their very eyes.
There are some very simple and powerful ways to turn the tables on this crisis and transform it into a wealth-building opportunity unlike anything we've seen in four decades.

[1]Charles Booker

Hi Peter,

I’m writing to you today to announce that I’m proudly endorsing Charles
Booker for U.S. Senate.

Charles is running to replace Rand Paul — and he’s campaigning on a bold
progressive vision that includes passing Medicare for All, holding special
interests accountable, and lifting up working people in Kentucky.

Charles isn’t just talking the talk – he’s lived the struggles other
politicians just talk about. He grew up in one of the poorest zip codes in
Kentucky. He experienced the pain of poverty firsthand, and saw his mom
skip meals just so he could have enough. He’s been homeless, and has had
to ration his insulin because he couldn’t afford the medication he needed
as a Type 1 diabetic.

Now, he’s running to lift up families in Kentucky and beyond. I couldn’t
be prouder to offer my support for his campaign, and today I’m asking for
your help.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220621.sY7hd2&refcode=em20220621-other-2101&t=1001&akid=2101%2E346206%2EUMZCut ]If you can, please chip in $5 in support of Charles’

| | **ICYMI: GOP legislator: Laura Kelly doesn’t govern from anywhere near the center

****By Patrick Penn

** [**_June 7, 2022, The Wichita Eagle._**](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=1bc9b55a1eea4293b4c3db72da2e1863&_e=aXij-yHspc1lxTgnv_mkzutRxR37Oj5fBMrLI72FqShGoUhQxjNgsy_swovg9_VcEa1spzIz_qxOmHukqj3tQ3YstSxC9zgasTdw4iMcrfgNkGB2cqVP_HkT-yc7C_WyzCnWTfCHlLsY7T7lcbevnoCjR3eQNnKz5RhiqKQXM1lVwrlTgYNHzKdEMpcS9S4By4GNi7mzqcFt94TrjbL5gU74AwwPyqlTjx5SOyF1GGfHXb-TwEb5vlOBFh_R9FEmvYrxRP5jgRuBsYiqUgr7Eqdm4ULrdsB_-3lEUmFIWzmB0z3FK84h2eE0dGdHZt3V)

Gov. Laura Kelly does not operate from the “middle of the road” of Kansas politics. In fact, she’s far from it. If the bipartisan persona were true, she wouldn’t have to be spending millions of dollars on television months before votes will be cast telling us about it. Kelly’s record paints a much different picture than what her focus-grouped and poll-tested ads would have you believe. For starters, she vetoed 13 bills this legislative session, which is more than any Kansas governor in nearly three decades. That’s after she vetoed 10 bills last session. Setting veto records is hardly “working with both sides.” Kelly’s vetoes, and her views on major issues of the day, are well outside the Kansas mainstream. For starters, she believes women should be forced to compete athletically with men. She vetoed the Fairness in Women’s Sports bill which would have enshrined in our state law something so decidedly non-controversial until only recently — that women should be afforded an equal opportunity as men in athletics. name: Fred Guttenberg
subject: Why I’m endorsing Nikki Fried for Governor
disclaimer_text: paid for and approved by Nikki Fried, Democrat, for Governor
body:
Peter,
In 2018, my daughter Jamie was killed in the Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School shooting — a devastating tragedy that took the lives of 16 other people.
To this day, it’s difficult to find the words to describe the grief of losing a child to a senseless act of gun violence. But, for the sake of my daughter and for the sake of people everywhere who’ve been impacted by gun violence, I’ve spent the last four years speaking out — turning my grief into action in the fight for common sense gun safety.
Nikki Fried has always been a friend and an ally to those of us working to change gun laws. She understands that fighting for common sense gun safety measures isn’t just a political position, it’s a fundamental necessity for our democracy to continue to function.
We can’t rely on the politics of the past anymore. If we want to see progress in the fight to make our churches, offices, parks, and schools a safer place to be, then we need to try something new — and that’s what Nikki will do as our next Governor.
I’m proud to stand with Nikki today, and I’m asking you to do the same. Will you chip in $20 to join me in supporting Nikki and fighting to bring something new to Florida? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-jun-2022?refcode=621guttenberg]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-jun-2022?refcode=621guttenberg [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-jun-2022?refcode=621guttenberg]
I know that Nikki will work tirelessly to make Florida a safer place for every family. I know she’ll do everything she can to enact common sense gun safety regulations. And I know that, with our support, she’ll succeed.
We need a Governor who understands that our safety is more important than scoring political points — a Governor who’s never taken a dime from the NRA and has consistently fought for common sense gun safety.
If you agree, I hope you’ll join me in supporting Nikki’s campaign and make a contribution today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-jun-2022?refcode=621guttenberg]
With thanks,
Fred Guttenberg

name: Charlie Gearing
subject: Please join me in supporting Liz Ginsburg
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Charlie Gearing for Texas
body:
Peter,

I ran for Texas State House this election cycle because I believe in democracy, good government, and common sense. Rachael and I remain committed to these ideals, and we recognize our state's urgent need for new leadership in Austin. So, we are staying active by supporting terrific candidates. One person we really believe in is Elizabeth Ginsberg, who is running for State House District 108.

Liz is a small business owner, a respected attorney, a longtime community volunteer and booster, and the mother of two amazing daughters. Like me, she chose to run for State House because the extremism and the attacks on our democracy, on women, and on LGBTQ+ Texans must stop, so we can put the focus back on helping Texans.

Like many pragmatic Democrats, Liz has no patience for right-wing extremists, including the incumbent in her district, who attacks our democratic elections and institutions and votes to remove our hard-fought rights, including reproductive rights. Liz will fight for our rights and defend our democracy, but her real passion is getting things done for constituents and leaving the culture wars behind. She will deal with our real challenges, like supporting homeowners, keeping property taxes under control, maintaining a good environment for business, and making sure our schools are funded.

It really is time for a change in HD 108. One-party rule in Texas has created a dynamic in which the most extreme right-wing base controls the Republican Party primaries, ensuring that our leadership represents only a sliver of Texas voters, rather than all of us. Liz has the intelligence, the work ethic, and the courage to mount a strong campaign and have a big impact in Austin once elected.

Liz can win in HD 108 and protect all Texans from the incumbent's extremist votes. I hope you will join me in supporting Liz. Please donate today at the link below and join us on June 23 from 6-8pm at the home of Rachael Wang and Andrew Sommerman, 4515 Harrys Lane Dallas, TX 75229.

Sincerely,

Charlie Gearing

Hi Peter, I've just published a new blog post: [This Isn't Satire](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQziooucjy1hu_U-tm2hNTHV6YpVPkzIVtdGETFH20dapHEAg&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june21_final&n=1) The Supermajority has taken the bold step of forming a “Select Committee” to figure out the “real” reason gas prices are so high. In a scene out of a bad political sitcom, a handful of Democrat legislators gathered in the Capitol press room to roll out the “Select Committee on Gasoline Supply and Pricing.” The Speaker was present, fidgeting nervously throughout. As context: there are 50 Select Committees in the Assembly, such as the Select Committee on the “State of Hate” and the Select Committee on Craft Beer. It’s not clear how many of these taxpayer-funded outfits have ever even met. But this new Select Committee, we were told, will get around to meeting – in “a number of weeks.” We also learned that following “negotiations” with Newsom, the long-promised “relief” – meager checks in the mail – will arrive about the same time as your ballot in October. Newsom and the Supermajority’s embarrassment was compounded by an unlikely source: Joe Biden. Even _he_ now wants to suspend the gas tax. When you make Biden look reasonable by comparison, that’s quite an accomplishment. But in good news, another dreadful COVID bill is in trouble as the school testing measure faces strong opposition in Assembly Health. And the anti-parent consent bill is languishing on the Assembly Floor, well short of the needed votes. The Legislature recesses for a month next Thursday. It will be an interesting next nine days. clean_body: | | | Friend, Last week I spoke at the Faith & Freedom conference. I want to make sure we are all on the same page — that no one believes the lies perpetuated by the Left. I want to make sure you know that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. While today’s Democrats don’t believe in America, it is up to us to reclaim our values and restore America’s moral courage. That is why it is so important to elect conservatives who believe in America — who fight for our values and uphold our principles. Friend, the Left sees America’s flaws as more profound than its strengths. They deny the massive progress we’ve made and punish anyone who disagrees. They are quick to praise those who attack America and eager to attack those who praise America. The American story is far greater than America’s flaws. I know this firsthand. I haven’t just seen the American story, I’ve lived it. As the proud daughter of Indian immigrants, the first female and first minority governor of South Carolina, and former UN Ambassador, I saw the promise of America unfold before me. America's founding remains the biggest leap forward for human freedom. My team is playing an important role in electing strong conservatives who uphold our founding principles. We are recruiting, training, advising, endorsing, and financially supporting conservative candidates throughout our country. We’ve already endorsed and supported over 40 candidates, and our work is far from finished. It will take everyone stepping up to ensure we have the resources necessary to win back our majorities in the House and Senate. That is why I am humbly asking for your help, friend. Your support will have an incredible impact on our nation’s future. My very best, Nikki R. Haley | A Note From Nikki: Growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys' Club and my opponent thought women shouldn’t be in politics. People thought I was too brown, too female, too young, too conservative, too principled. I said: Too bad. I was inspired by great women who broke barriers and defied expectations, women like Margaret Thatcher and Jeane Kirkpatrick. That’s why I wrote this book. Liberty Rocks
---
Ann Barthrop had a full house at Tony's Mountain Pizza for another great Liberty Rocks gathering. It was special to listen to so many folks who want to send an economist to Congress to improve the economy and restore the paths to the middle class.
---
Jeffco Debate
---
Thanks to the Jefferson County House District Captains who organized and promoted a great opportunity to hear the distinct differences in CD7 candidates and for providing an opportunity for voters to hear how candidates will approach policies on everything from education and the economy to international affairs and healthcare.
---
---
Day of Action
---
Our team knocked on thousands of doors and made tens of thousands of phone calls. Thanks to all the volunteers who communicated with voters and spread the word about Tim and his plans to restore the middle class.
---
Arvada on Tap
---
Arvada on Tap provided a great opportunity for Tim to meet with folks and discuss how to make gas and groceries affordable again while festival attendees tasted the amazing BBQ provided by contestants. Congratulations to the winners!
---
---
Evergreen Rodeo Parade
---
Thanks to the owners and drivers of the three amazing classic vehicles for Team Reichert in the Evergreen Rodeo Parade. It was the perfect opportunity to chat with parade watchers and share Tim's plan for lowering gas prices, improving the economy and restoring the middle class.

Friends,

This week we may be on the cusp of the Supreme Court striking down Roe v. Wade.

This will be a very sad day for our nation.

We arrived at this moment because Mitch McConnell shamelessly packed the Supreme Court with radical right-wing extremists.

The Supreme Court’s ruling on this case could overturn all that Roe v. Wade has protected for the last 48 years.

We don’t need politicians or judges interfering with anyone’s right to choose. As a co-author of the Pennsylvania Women’s Health Protection Act, I will never stop fighting to protect abortion access.

If we have to navigate this painful outcome, I encourage everyone to be gentle with themselves. I know how deeply held the right to choose is for each of us.

Best,

MK

Rick Caruso doesn't have one.

Team,

This April, I unveiled [my climate and sustainability plan for Los Angeles](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46801337/351830844/1454842613?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzEyZWY4YS1jNGYxLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EgiHUYgUS-zOfUoMtIN9TigHMu6Qth6yZ3vctDZ3GY8=&emci=0c29ad27-a5f1-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=c312ef8a-c4f1-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2429742). An increasing number of Americans believe that addressing climate change should be a top priority for our nation’s leaders, and I couldn’t agree more.

The climate crisis is among our city's greatest challenges – and it’s an important opportunity for Los Angeles to rebuild its infrastructure and invest in a more equitable future.

**Rick Caruso has introduced ZERO plans to address the climate crisis.** This is unacceptable from someone who is running to be our city's next mayor.

The catastrophic effects of climate change require us to transform our economy and address decades of environmental injustice that have left communities overburdened by pollution and underinvestment. Unlike Caruso, I have a plan, and it is bold and unwavering in its intent to make a real difference.

There is no reason why Los Angeles cannot transition away from fossil fuels. I know that our city can achieve its goal of 100 percent clean power by 2035. We will work to dramatically reduce vehicle emissions, get people out of their cars, decarbonize buildings, secure a zero-emission Port of Los Angeles, and appoint environmental champions to get the job done.

Team, this is just one aspect of our vision. I have a plan to ensure all thrive in a clean economy, build healthy and resilient communities, secure a sustainable water future, and protect and expand nature for all Angelenos. **That’s what our city deserves – a leader with a vision and a plan!**

Once again, thank you for your dedication. Let’s keep this momentum going.

— Annie

| | | **_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

Jesse Reising comes from a long line of Central Illinoisans, with his ancestors arriving by horseback among the first 300 settlers in Decatur in the 1830s. He was recruited from the heartland public school system to attend and play football at Yale University. While Jesse was a starting linebacker for Yale and a Marine Corps Officer Candidate, he suffered a massive neck injury during a football game. It left him partially paralyzed and ended his plans to join the Marine Corps. Jesse set out to do three things to replace his Marine Corps Service: (1) go to Afghanistan to support the United States military’s efforts as a civilian; (2) co-found the Warrior-Scholar Project to serve those serving in the military; and (3) serve his country as a federal prosecutor. After graduating from Yale, Jesse achieved all 3 of his goals. As a federal prosecutor, Jesse prosecuted white-collar criminals and foreign business executives who were manipulating American economic markets. The cases Jesse prosecuted resulted in the recovery of over $100 million for the American taxpayer. My entire team is working hard, and there are multiple ways you can support while we're fighting for your rights as a true American. - Thank you for your support...in any way possible. We will continue to fight for your rights throughout the next week and beyond election day. Don’t forget to mark your calendars to vote on June 28! Thank you,Team Reising | | | | | | | Jesse Reising comes from a long line of Central Illinoisans, with his ancestors arriving by horseback among the first 300 settlers in Decatur in the 1830s. He was recruited from the heartland public school system to attend and play football at Yale University. While Jesse was a starting linebacker for Yale and a Marine Corps Officer Candidate, he suffered a massive neck injury during a football game. It left him partially paralyzed and ended his plans to join the Marine Corps. Jesse set out to do three things to replace his Marine Corps Service: (1) go to Afghanistan to support the United States military’s efforts as a civilian; (2) co-found the Warrior-Scholar Project to serve those serving in the military; and (3) serve his country as a federal prosecutor. After graduating from Yale, Jesse achieved all 3 of his goals. As a federal prosecutor, Jesse prosecuted white-collar criminals and foreign business executives who were manipulating American economic markets. The cases Jesse prosecuted resulted in the recovery of over $100 million for the American taxpayer. Now Jesse is running for Congress so he can continue to protect taxpayers, strengthen the economy, stand by law enforcement, empower veterans to succeed, and protect the agriculture industry that is vital to central Illinois. | |

body:
A new PAC plans to raise over $1 million to try and unseat Representative Rashida Tlaib.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220621-3124-header&t=1&akid=3124%2E2526796%2ExQNfO9)
Republicans are funneling millions of dollars into Democratic primaries.
**Case in point is a new PAC that plans to raise over $1 million to try and unseat Representative Rashida Tlaib.** 1
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220621.xG7Lps&refcode=em20220621-3124-P_FND_SPL_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3124%2E2526796%2ExQNfO9)
It’s up to all of us to protect Rashida and make sure that her campaign has the resources it needs to fight back and win.
[If you’re able to, can you split a donation between Rashida and Alexandria’s campaigns to help them fight back against dark money and win reelection this November?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220621.xG7Lps&refcode=em20220621-3124-P_FND_SPL_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3124%2E2526796%2ExQNfO9)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220621.xG7Lps&refcode=em20220621-3124-P_FND_SPL_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3124%2E2526796%2ExQNfO9)**
The PAC is primarily funded by a billionaire hedge fund investor who has given over $1 million to GOP committees and candidates this year – and $125,000 to the Democratic Majority for Israel (DMFI) PAC.2
**Alexandria put it best:**
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220621.xG7Lps&refcode=em20220621-3124-P_FND_SPL_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=3124%2E2526796%2ExQNfO9)
**Together we can send a huge amount of grassroots donations to Alexandria and Rashida and send a signal to this PAC and GOP donors that our movement is organized and ready to fight to defend our seats.**
[Please chip in anything you can here and your donation will be split automatically.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220621.xG7Lps&refcode=em20220621-3124-P_FND_SPL_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=24&akid=3124%2E2526796%2ExQNfO9)
We know that people power is stronger than special interest money. Let’s show what we can do when we band together.
Thank you for everything.
Team AOC

Peter,
My Wyoming roots run deep. My family has been in Wyoming for generations, and I was raised on a ranch near Fort Laramie. That is where I learned the values of hard work and determination. I have always loved this great state; for me it represents freedom, liberty, personal responsibility, resiliency, family and community. I learned Wyoming Tough values at a young age. Sadly enough, Wyoming values have not been represented in Congress for far too long. That needs to change, and I aim to change it.
I have fought for the people of Wyoming most of my career, taking on the Clinton Administration, the Obama Administration, and the Biden Administration. I have pushed back against their unlawful power grabs and unconstitutional overreach. Now I am taking that same fight to Congress. The people of Wyoming are concerned about the disastrous policies of the Biden Agenda. They miss the America First policies that allowed our state to flourish. Today, our lone Congresswoman is not only refusing to fight back against the Democrats, she has joined their team – working with the likes of Adam Schiff, Jamie Raskin, and Nancy Pelosi -- in a ridiculous witch hunt against President Trump. I was not willing to sit back and watch while Liz Cheney uses our state – MY STATE – to pursue her own political vendetta, and decided enough was enough. The hard-working people of this state deserve a government that will work for them so that they can achieve their American Dream. When I am elected, I will get the government out of your way, unleash our energy industry, protect the 2nd Amendment, and put our great state first.
**Join My Team Today to put Wyoming First!****

clean_body: | | | | I will bring our voice back to Congress | Peter, My Wyoming roots run deep. My family has been in Wyoming for generations, and I was raised on a ranch near Fort Laramie. That is where I learned the values of hard work and determination. I have always loved this great state; for me it represents freedom, liberty, personal responsibility, resiliency, family and community. I learned Wyoming Tough values at a young age. Sadly enough, Wyoming values have not been represented in Congress for far too long. That needs to change, and I aim to change it. I have fought for the people of Wyoming most of my career, taking on the Clinton Administration, the Obama Administration, and the Biden Administration. I have pushed back against their unlawful power grabs and unconstitutional overreach. Now I am taking that same fight to Congress. The people of Wyoming are concerned about the disastrous policies of the Biden Agenda. They miss the America First policies that allowed our state to flourish. Today, our lone Congresswoman is not only refusing to fight back against the Democrats, she has joined their team – working with the likes of Adam Schiff, Jamie Raskin, and Nancy Pelosi -- in a ridiculous witch hunt against President Trump. I was not willing to sit back and watch while Liz Cheney uses our state – MY STATE – to pursue her own political vendetta, and decided enough was enough. The hard-working people of this state deserve a government that will work for them so that they can achieve their American Dream. When I am elected, I will get the government out of your way, unleash our energy industry, protect the 2nd Amendment, and put our great state first. Join My Team Today to put Wyoming First! | | | | | | | For Wyoming, | | Harriet Hageman | | | | | DONATE BY MAIL: Hageman for Wyoming P.O. Box 4157, Cheyenne, Wyoming 82003

clean_body: The one thing we don’t get back is time. | Fellow American, Can you guess which race is at the top of the list? If you guessed Georgia, then you'd be right. The most recent poll - out last week - had our race with Raphael Warnock TIED at 46%. If you are someone who believes that winning back the Senate is a done deal, then we urge you to reconsider. While it feels like Republicans have momentum on our side as Americans are upset at what Joe Biden and the Democrats have done to our country and economy, the states with competitive Senate races are not easy wins for Republicans. Last week's poll reminds us that money matters, and it is one thing national Democrats seem to have an unlimited supply of. Unfortunately, the infusion of cash into Georgia has allowed our opponent to keep up a weekly drumbeat of nearly $1 million in tv ads, which we cannot afford to respond to yet. If we're going to set the record straight about the attacks, take our conservative message directly to the voters, win this race, and avoid having to live through two more years of a Senate run by Democrats, then we need to turn up the heat TODAY. The only way we're going to win in Georgia is by getting on equal financial footing as our opponent. That's why we're coming to you with this urgent request today. Our opponent has spent MILLIONS attacking me, and we can see from the polling his misleading ads are beginning to have an impact. We've set a goal of raising $5,000 by midnight tonight. The one thing we don't get back is time. In 139 days from today - believe it or not - the election will have come and gone. Don't you want to be able to say that you did your part to get America back on track? I look forward to seeing your name on the list of donors who stepped up when it mattered most.
